elf_loomer.again: YOU'RE BACK. YOU DIDN'T TOUCH THE WARP. I LIKE YOU.

topics.a: I WEAVE THE COURT'S CLOTH - THE QUEEN'S GREEN, THE WARDENS' GREY, THE GOLD FOR THE BANNERS. SEFA DOES THE FINE SILK. I DO THE MILES OF IT.
SEFA WOVE A WHOLE BOLT OF THE FIRST SWORD'S FAVOUR SILK IN THE SPRING. A WHOLE BOLT. FOR ONE RIBBON. YOU WORK IT OUT.
THREE CITIES, REALLY. DOWN HERE IS FOR WORK - THE MARKET, THE MAKERS. THE BOUGHS ARE FOR LIVING; THE CROWN IS FOR THE QUEEN AND THE STARS. THE LIFT TAKES YOU UP IF YOUR KNEES ARE OLD. MINE ARE.

elf_grocer.name: Merrow
elf_grocer.greet: STARPEARS! FROM THE CANOPY ORCHARDS THIS MORNING. CUT ONE ACROSS AND THERE'S A STAR IN IT. GO ON. EVERYONE'S DELIGHTED THE FIRST TIME.
elf_grocer.again: BACK FOR THE STAR AGAIN? IT'S STILL THERE. IT'S ALWAYS THERE.

topics.a: STARPEARS, WAYBREAD - ONE BITE AND YOU COULD WALK TILL DARK - AND HONEY THAT CAME ALL THE WAY FROM VERDANCE IN A CRATE, BECAUSE MIRELLE WANTS IT FOR HER BREWING AND WON'T SAY WHY.
MY FAMILY'S HAD THIS STALL SINCE BEFORE THE SQUARE WAS PAVED. MY GRANDMOTHER SOLD THE QUEEN HER FIRST STARPEAR. SHE STILL BUYS ONE EVERY MIDSUMMER. THE QUEEN, I MEAN. GRANDMOTHER'S GONE WEST.

elf_liftkeeper.name: Brannoc
elf_liftkeeper.greet: UP? IN YOU GET. KEEP YOUR HANDS INSIDE THE BASKET AND YOUR OPINIONS ABOUT THE ROPE TO YOURSELF. IT'S A GOOD ROPE.

topics.a: I'VE WOUND THIS WINCH FOR FOUR HUNDRED YEARS. THE COUNTERWEIGHT IS THE SAME STONES IT ALWAYS WAS. THE ROPE I CHANGE EVERY SPRING, WHATEVER PEOPLE THINK.

WHERE MOST OF THE CITY LIVES: HOMES ON PLATFORMS ROUND THE TRUNKS, BRIDGES OF ROPE BETWEEN. THE HOLLOW BOUGH'S UP THERE - THE TAVERN IN A BRANCH SO BIG A HUNDRED ELVES CAN DANCE IN IT. AND THE QUEEN'S STAIR UP TO THE CROWN.

idris.name: Idris Thorne
idris.role: Morwen's old master. Drowned with Saltmere; she didn't let him go
idris.greet: AH. A VISITOR WITH A PULSE. SIT, IF YOU LIKE. I CAN'T. MORWEN DREW THIS CIRCLE TO KEEP ME, AND SHE DRAWS A VERY GOOD CIRCLE.
idris.again: STILL WARM, I SEE. GOOD. ONE OF US SHOULD BE.

topics.a: IDRIS THORNE. I TAUGHT MORWEN THE WEAVE WHEN SHE WAS ELEVEN AND HAD SET FIRE TO HER FATHER'S BOAT WITH A THOUGHT. I WAS A GOOD TEACHER AND A POOR SWIMMER. THE SECOND MATTERED MORE, ONE NIGHT.

A VILLAGE ON A LOW ISLAND SOUTH-WEST OF HERE. FIFTY HOUSES, A CHAPEL, A QUAY. THE NIGHT THE SEA CAME UP, MORWEN AND I HELD A WARD ROUND IT TILL DAWN. IT HELD FOR THE CHAPEL TOWER. IT DID NOT HOLD FOR ME. THE VILLAGE IS STILL THERE, HALF UNDER THE WATER. SO ARE ITS PEOPLE, IN A MANNER OF SPEAKING.

SALTMERE'S BELL STILL HANGS IN THE CHAPEL TOWER, AND IN THE DARK OF THE MOON IT RINGS ITSELF. THE DROWNED SAY IT RINGS FOR THE GLOAMING - THE BOAT THAT WENT OUT FOR HELP THAT NIGHT AND NEVER CAME BACK. IT IS STILL OUT THERE, YOU KNOW. LOOKING FOR THE WAY HOME.

SALTMERE'S OLD PACKET BOAT. SHE PUT OUT INTO THE STORM WITH SIX ABOARD TO FETCH THE ABBEY'S BOATS, AND THE SEA HAD HER. SAILORS SEE HER NOW AND THEN, GREEN LANTERNS IN THE MIST, SAILING AGAINST THE WIND. IF YOU EVER BOARD HER - AND ONLY A FOOL WOULD - LOOK FOR HER LANTERN. A SHIP FINDS HER WAY HOME BY HER OWN LIGHT.

SHE BLAMES HERSELF. SHE SHOULDN'T. SHE WAS SEVENTEEN AND SHE HELD BACK THE SEA FOR NINE HOURS. I'VE TOLD HER SO EVERY DAY FOR FIFTY YEARS. SHE BRINGS ME TEA I CAN'T DRINK AND WE ARGUE ABOUT ASTRONOMY. IT'S NOT A BAD AFTERLIFE.

UP THE STAIR. HER ORRERY - THE SEVEN WORLDS YOUR SHIP KNOWS, THOUGH SHE BUILT IT LONG BEFORE ANY OF YOU CAME. AND THE SCRYING POOL: LOOK IN IT AT NIGHT. IT SHOWS THE SEA AS IT IS NOW, AND WHAT'S SAILING ON IT.

aubert.name: Monsieur Aubert
aubert.greet: WELCOME TO AURELLE. YOU LOOK AS IF THE MOUNTAIN HAS BEEN UNKIND TO YOU. THE CHATEAU WILL BE KINDER.

topics.a: THIRTY-ONE YEARS AT THIS DOOR. I HAVE FOUND A PRINCE'S DOG, A DUCHESS'S HUSBAND AND, ONCE, A WHOLE STRING QUARTET IN THE WRONG HOTEL. I HAVE NEVER LOST A KEY. I DO NOT INTEND TO START.
OF COURSE.

MADAME HELOISE AURELLE BUILT A SANATORIUM HERE FOR THE AIR. THE AIR WAS EXCELLENT; THE PATIENTS PREFERRED CARDS. NOW THERE IS THE SALON, THE THERMES, LA TABLE, AND A TRAIN THAT BRINGS PEOPLE UP FROM FELLHAVEN TO SPEND MONEY IN ALL OF THEM.

A GENTLEMAN WON AT THE CRAPS TABLE LAST NIGHT FOR FOUR HOURS AND THEN LOST IT ALL IN FOUR MINUTES. HE TIPPED ME BEFORE THE FOUR MINUTES. A WISE MAN. AND THE GUIDES SAY THE VALLEY BEYOND THE COL IS STEAMING AGAIN. THEY ALWAYS SAY THAT IN WINTER.

anouk.name: Anouk Varenne
anouk.greet: YOU WANT TO GO ROUND THE TOWN? THE GREY'S BEEN WAITING ALL MORNING FOR SOMEBODY WORTH PULLING.

topics.a: UP YOU GET.
MY GRANDFATHER DROVE THE MAIL SLEIGH OVER THE COL BEFORE THERE WAS A RAILWAY. NOW I DRIVE BANKERS ROUND A FIR TREE. THE HORSES PREFER THE BANKERS. LIGHTER.
THE GREY IS PERLE. THE BAY IS FERNAND. PERLE IS CLEVER AND FERNAND IS HANDSOME AND THEY BOTH KNOW IT. BRING THEM AN APPLE AND YOU'LL HAVE FRIENDS FOR LIFE.

mathis.name: Mathis Roux
mathis.role: Mountain guide, the bureau des guides, Aurelle
mathis.greet: YOU'VE GOT THE LOOK. THE ONE THAT SAYS YOU'VE BEEN STARING AT THE GLACIER FROM THE TERRACE. SIT DOWN.
mathis.again: THE MOUNTAIN'S STILL THERE. SO AM I.

topics.a: THREE DAYS.
I'VE CROSSED THE COL A HUNDRED AND TWELVE TIMES. FELL IN THE GLACIER TWICE. MARRIED THE WARDEN OF THE CABANE BLEUE ONCE. SHE STILL WON'T LET ME OVER WITHOUT A NIGHT'S SLEEP.
WARM UNDER THE SNOW. HOT SPRINGS, MOSS, AN OLD MONASTERY ON A CLIFF. WOLVES ON THE OUTER SLOPES, WORSE FURTHER IN. AND THE BIG WHITE ONES - YOU'LL SEE THEM IF THEY LET YOU. BE PATIENT WITH THEM.

hut-odile.name: Odile Roux
hut-odile.greet: BOOTS OFF. SKINS ON THE RACK. SOUP'S HOT. IN THAT ORDER.

topics.a: SIT.
OVER THE COL AT FIRST LIGHT, BEFORE THE WIND GETS UP. THEN THE BOWL - SKI IT, DON'T WALK IT, YOU'LL BE UP TO YOUR WAIST. BRAM'S AT THE BOTTOM. TELL HIM HIS SOCKS ARE STILL HERE.
TWENTY WINTERS UP HERE. MATHIS BRINGS THE GUESTS UP AND I SEND THEM ON. HE THINKS HE'S IN CHARGE. I LET HIM.

hut-bram.name: Bram Holt
hut-bram.role: Warden of the Refuge du Col
hut-bram.greet: YOU SKIED THE BOWL? GOOD SNOW TODAY. SIT. THERE'S STEW, AND THERE'S MORE STEW.

topics.a: OF COURSE.

DOWN THROUGH THE LARCHES TOMORROW, THEN THE STEAM. THE WOLVES HUNT IN THREES ON THE OUTER SLOPES. THE CAVES ARE FULL OF THINGS THAT CLICK. THE MONKS LEFT THE MONASTERY YEARS AGO AND SOMETHING COLD MOVED IN. AND AT THE HEART OF IT, UNDER THE SNOW - NOBODY'S SEEN IT. EVERYBODY'S HEARD IT.
I WAS A CHEF IN AURELLE. LA TABLE. THREE STARS. I CAME UP HERE FOR ONE SEASON TO GET AWAY FROM THE STARS, AND STAYED FOR THE OTHER KIND.

stationmaster.name: Petra Lind
stationmaster.greet: THE AURELLE LINE. UP THE GORGE, OVER THE VIADUCT, ROUND THE GLACIER AND THROUGH THE MOUNTAIN.
stationmaster.again: THE TRAIN'S IN. IT'S ALWAYS IN.

topics.a: ALL ABOARD.
FORTY YEARS TO BUILD, NINE TUNNELS, THE GREAT VIADUCT - TWO HUNDRED FEET OVER THE GORGE AND NOT ONE RIVET LOOSE. SIT ON THE LEFT GOING UP. YOU'LL THANK ME AT THE GLACIER.
I DROVE THE TRAINS FOR TWENTY YEARS. NOW I WAVE THEM OFF. I STILL KNOW EVERY CURVE BY THE SOUND OF THE WHEELS.

kaspar.name: Kaspar Imhof
kaspar.greet: COME IN, COME IN, THE CHEESE IS READY AND THE CHEESE DOES NOT WAIT.

topics.a: SIT.
MY FATHER STIRRED THIS POT, AND HIS MOTHER, AND HERS. IN FIGURES OF EIGHT. NEVER CIRCLES. CIRCLES ARE FOR TOURISTS.
ONCE IT WAS COWS AND GUIDES. THEN THE LIFT, THEN THE TRAIN, NOW THE PROMENADE AND THE ALPENHOF AND PEOPLE IN FUR COATS ON THE RINK. STILL THE SAME SNOW. STILL THE SAME CHEESE.

anselm.name: Brother Anselm
anselm.role: The last monk of the cliff monastery
anselm.greet: A VISITOR. OVER THE COL, IN THIS SEASON. SIT BY THE BRAZIER. THE TEA HAS BUTTER IN IT; YOU WILL GET USED TO IT.

topics.a: THE SPRINGS WARMED THE VALLEY AND THE VALLEY FED US, FOR A THOUSAND YEARS. THEN ONE WINTER THE GLACIER STIRRED. SOMETHING UNDER IT WOKE AND ROLLED OVER, AND THE COLD CAME UP THE STAIR. THE STONES IN THE COURTYARD GOT UP AND WALKED. MY BROTHERS LEFT. I DID NOT.

THE GOLEMS ARE RIME AND RUBBLE - SLOW, BUT WHEN THEY RAISE THEIR FISTS, STEP AWAY. FIRE CRACKS THEIR CRUST. THE WRAITHS WERE ONCE MY BROTHERS' FEARS, I THINK. THEY HATE A HOLY EDGE. CLEAR THE COURTYARD AND RING THE BELL; THE ICE ON THE GATE WILL HEAR IT.

THE NORTH-EAST GATE GOES OUT ONTO THE HIGH SNOW WHERE THE GLACIER BEGINS. THE HEART OF IT. WHAT WOKE IS THERE, SWIMMING UNDER THE SNOW LIKE A FISH UNDER ICE. WATCH THE SNOW. IT WILL TELL YOU WHERE IT RISES.
THE YETIS? OLD FRIENDS OF THIS HOUSE. THEY BRING US WOOD; WE LEAVE THEM BERRIES AND SALT. SHY AS DEER. NEVER RUN AT ONE. SIT STILL, OFFER SOMETHING, COME BACK TOMORROW. AND THE DAY AFTER.

roo.name: Mama Roo
roo.greet: SIT. EAT. YOU LOOK LIKE SOMEONE FROM UP TOP WHO TOOK A WRONG TURN. EVERYONE DOWN HERE TOOK A WRONG TURN ONCE.
roo.again: BACK AGAIN. GOOD. THE BROTH REMEMBERS YOU.

topics.a: FORTY YEARS AT THIS COUNTER. MY MOTHER BEFORE ME. THE POT IS OLDER THAN BOTH OF US. WHEN THEY BUILT THE DISTRICT ON TOP OF US WE KEPT COOKING. THE STEAM GOES UP THROUGH THE GRATES. THEY SMELL US UP THERE, YOU KNOW. THEY JUST DON'T COME DOWN.

HAWKER HALL FOR FOOD, THE DRIP FOR DRINK, THE FOUNDRY IF YOU WANT YOUR EARS TO BLEED, THE PIT IF YOU WANT THE REST OF YOU TO. SALLOW FOR CHROME, IF YOU MUST. AND KEEP OFF THE SAINTS' SIDE OF THE FENCE UNLESS YOU'RE LOOKING FOR TROUBLE.

THE ORANGE VESTS. THEY HOLD THE YARDS PAST THE FENCE AND THEY TAKE A CUT OF EVERYTHING THAT GOES THROUGH. THEIR BOSS CALLS HIMSELF SAINT RUIN. CHROME FIST. SITS ON A THRONE MADE OF A CAR. IF SOMEONE EVER KNOCKED HIM OFF IT I'D GIVE THEM BROTH FOR A YEAR.
THE STAIRS BY THE CANAL GO DOWN TO THE SUMP: THE OLD STREET, UNDER THE WATER. THERE'S A SHRINE DOWN THERE, AND OLD TEO'S BOAT, AND A PARTY THAT NEVER STOPS. AND THINGS IN THE WATER. EAT FIRST.
DOOR'S OPEN. DON'T START ANYTHING. DON'T FINISH ANYTHING EITHER.
I STAND HERE. PEOPLE BEHAVE. THAT'S THE WHOLE JOB.
OLD SMELTING HALL. STATIC LIT THE FURNACE AGAIN WITH LAMPS. DANCE ON THE GRATING, DRINK THE TONIC, DON'T CLIMB THE LADLE. SOMEBODY ALWAYS CLIMBS THE LADLE.

tally.name: Tally
tally.greet: BETTING OR SIGHTSEEING? SIGHTSEEING'S FREE. BETTING'S WHERE THE FUN IS.

topics.a: HOUSE BOUT EVERY TWENTY MINUTES. TWO FIGHTERS, ODDS ON THE BOARD. PICK ONE, PUT YOUR COINS DOWN, THE BELL GOES. SAME BOUT FOR EVERYONE IN THE ROOM, SAME RESULT. I DON'T FIX THEM. MUCH.
ANYONE CAN CLIMB IN. TWENTY TO GET IN, THREE ROUNDS AGAINST THE HOUSE, EACH ONE PAYS BETTER. THE THIRD ROUND'S A HUSK FROM THE SUMP. NOBODY LIKES THE THIRD ROUND.
WATCH THE GROUND. EVERYONE TELEGRAPHS. ROLL OUT OF IT. AND IRON MAE NEVER GOES DOWN IN THE FIRST, SO DON'T BET THAT SHE WILL.

sallow.name: Doc Sallow
sallow.greet: SIT IN THE CHAIR OR DON'T. BUT DON'T TOUCH THE JARS.
sallow.again: HOW'S THE CHROME? STILL TWITCHING? GOOD. MEANS IT'S ALIVE.

topics.a: I WAS A SURGEON UP TOP ONCE. CLINIC GRADE, LICENCE AND ALL. THEN I PUT A FEW THINGS IN A FEW PEOPLE THAT THE LICENCE DIDN'T COVER. NOW I PUT EVERYTHING IN EVERYONE, AND NOBODY ASKS FOR THE LICENCE.

CHEAP, STRONG, SECOND-HAND. IT GLITCHES. AN ARM THAT FORGETS A SWING, LEGS THAT LOCK, PLATE THAT DROPS OUT FOR A FEW SECONDS. IN A FIGHT, MORE. NAKURI UP ON THE DISTRICT CAN TUNE IT STEADY, IF YOU CAN STAND HER SNIFFING AT MY WORK.

BRING ME SAINT RUIN'S FIST AND I'LL PUT IT ON YOUR ARM. BRING ME THE HEART OUT OF THE DREDGE AND I'LL PUT IT IN YOUR CHEST. THAT'S CHROME WORTH HAVING. IT DOESN'T GLITCH: IT WAS PAID FOR IN BLOOD ALREADY.
MED-KITS AND STIMS ON THE BENCH. THEY'RE THE REAL THING. MOSTLY.

static.name: Static
static.greet: CAN'T HEAR YOU. CAN'T HEAR ANYTHING. THAT'S THE POINT.
static.again: STILL STANDING? TURN IT UP THEN.

topics.a: I MAKE MUSIC OUT OF THE NOISE THE CITY MAKES. HYDRAULICS. PRESSES. THE LIFT CABLES SINGING. I RECORDED THE FOUNDRY THE NIGHT THEY SHUT IT. EVERY TRACK I PLAY HAS THAT IN IT SOMEWHERE.
UP TOP? KIRI'S ALL RIGHT. CLEAN SOUND. TOO CLEAN. DOWN HERE IT RATTLES YOUR TEETH. THAT'S HOW YOU KNOW IT'S REAL.
LUX. DOWN IN THE OLD STATION. NEVER STOPS. I PLAY THERE ON THE NIGHTS I CAN'T SLEEP, WHICH IS MOST NIGHTS.

gage.name: Gage
gage.greet: SCRAP? BOARDS? CHROME? I BUY. I DON'T ASK.

topics.a: SCRAP BY THE PIECE, CIRCUIT BOARDS BY THE BOARD, CHROME PARTS BY THE POUND. PEARLS OUT OF THE SUMP, IF YOU'VE BEEN THAT FAR. EEL I LEAVE TO TEO.
THE SAINTS DROP IT WHEN YOU DROP THEM. THE HEAPS IN THE YARD, IF YOU DON'T MIND RATS. THE DRONES IN THE SUMP ARE FULL OF BOARDS. EVERYTHING UP TOP ENDS UP DOWN HERE IN THE END.

teo.name: Old Teo
teo.greet: LAKSA? SIT ON THE QUAY, MIND THE EDGE. THE WATER DOESN'T GIVE BACK WHAT IT TAKES.
teo.again: HUNGRY AGAIN. GOOD. THE SUMP MAKES YOU HUNGRY.

topics.a: I'VE BEEN ON THIS WATER SINCE IT WAS A STREET. MY FATHER HAD A SHOP ON IT. THEN THE CITY CAME DOWN ON TOP OF US AND THE WATER CAME UP UNDERNEATH, AND I BOUGHT A BOAT. YOU MAKE THE BEST OF WHERE YOU ARE.
THE SUMP EELS COME UP OUT OF THE CANALS. THEY BITE HARD. BUT THE MEAT GLOWS, AND IT MAKES A BROTH YOU WON'T FORGET. BRING ME ONE AND I'LL PAY.

AN OLD DREDGER. THEY LEFT IT RUNNING WHEN THEY ABANDONED THE STREET. IT'S BEEN DREDGING FIFTY YEARS WITH NOBODY AT THE CONTROLS, AND SOMEWHERE IN THERE IT GOT ANGRY. COMES UP BY THE SOUTH BASIN. SISTER WEN SAYS IT'S LONELY. I SAY IT'S A MACHINE.

wen.name: Sister Wen
wen.greet: YOU CAME ALL THE WAY DOWN. SIT ON THE STEP. THE WATER IS QUIET TODAY.
wen.again: THE CANDLES LEANED WHEN YOU CAME. THEY DO THAT FOR PEOPLE THEY LIKE.

topics.a: IT WAS HERE BEFORE THE CITY. WHEN THEY BUILT OVER THE STREET THEY LEFT IT, AND THE GATE, BECAUSE THE BUILDERS WERE AFRAID TO MOVE THEM. THE WATER CAME UP TO THE THIRD STEP AND STOPPED. IT HAS NEVER COME HIGHER.
A COIN FOR THE WATER AND A BOW. ONCE A DAY IT GIVES BACK: YOUR STRENGTH, YOUR BREATH. AND IF YOU FALL DOWN HERE, IT BRINGS YOU TO MY STEPS. IT HAS DONE THAT FOR MANY PEOPLE.
PEOPLE WHO PUT IN TOO MUCH CHROME AND LET THE CHROME DECIDE. THEY WALK THE QUAYS. THEY DON'T REMEMBER THEIR NAMES. BE GENTLE WITH THEM IF YOU CAN, AND QUICK IF YOU CAN'T.

lux.name: Lux
lux.greet: WELCOME TO CENTRAL! LAST STOP! EVERYBODY OFF! EVERYBODY DANCE!
lux.again: YOU CAME BACK DOWN! NOBODY COMES BACK DOWN!

topics.a: I FOUND THIS PLACE WHEN I WAS NINE, CLIMBING DOWN THE OLD VENT SHAFTS. A WHOLE STATION, UNDER THE WATER, AND THE POWER STILL ON IN THE CARRIAGE. I SAID: ONE DAY THIS IS GOING TO BE THE BEST PARTY IN THE CITY. IT IS.
NOT SINCE I STARTED IT. THREE YEARS, FOUR MONTHS. PEOPLE TAKE TURNS ON THE DECKS WHEN I SLEEP. STATIC COMES DOWN SOMETIMES. EVEN TEO DANCED ONCE.
TEAL LIGHT IN A TUBE, FROM THE CARRIAGE BAR. IT'S MOSTLY SUGAR AND SOMETHING THAT GLOWS. YOU'LL DANCE TILL MORNING. THERE IS NO MORNING DOWN HERE, SO, FOREVER.

vesper.name: Vesper Quick
vesper.role: The fence on Cinder Key. Buys what others won't
vesper.greet: VESPER QUICK. I BUY WHAT THE HONEST WON'T TOUCH AND I PAY WHAT THE HONEST WOULDN'T. WHATEVER YOU'VE GOT, I'VE SEEN WORSE. WHAT ARE YOU SELLING?
vesper.again: BACK AGAIN. YOU'VE GOT THAT LOOK - LIKE SOMETHING IN YOUR PACK IS STARING AT YOU.

topics.a: SILVER WITH THE CREST SCRATCHED OFF. OTHER PEOPLE'S RINGS. IDOLS THAT ARE WARM WHEN THEY SHOULDN'T BE. LOCKETS OFF THE DROWNED. SERPENT SCALES, MAW INK, PEARLS, HERON SILVER, GLASS FROM THE CRATER. NO QUESTIONS, NO RECEIPTS.

PIRATES YOU'VE BEATEN, MOSTLY. THEY CARRY WHAT THEY'VE TAKEN, AND WHEN THEY STRIKE THEIR COLOURS IT'S YOURS. THE HONEST TRADERS WON'T BUY IT BECAUSE SOMEBODY MIGHT RECOGNISE IT. I DON'T MIND BEING RECOGNISED. IT'S GOOD FOR BUSINESS.
THE BLACK GULL. RAN AGROUND IN THE COVE THE YEAR I WAS BORN AND ROLLED OVER IN A GALE. MY MOTHER SAW A ROOF WHERE EVERYONE ELSE SAW A WRECK. I SAW A COUNTER.
THAT ONE COMES BACK. I SELL IT TO A CAPTAIN, HE LOSES A FIGHT, THE MAN WHO BEAT HIM BRINGS IT TO ME. NINE TIMES NOW. I'VE STARTED TO THINK IT LIKES IT HERE.

A GREEN SHIP IN THE MIDNIGHT SEA, SAILING AGAINST THE WIND. THE DROWNED ABOARD HER CARRY LOCKETS, AND I'LL TAKE EVERY ONE. AND THE DRAGON ON CRIMSON REACH HAS BEEN RESTLESS. THE CRATER UP THE HILL GLOWS BRIGHTER WHEN SHE IS.

dee.name: Scarlet Dee
dee.role: Keeps Cinder Key's harbour. Tortuga's, if you're a pirate
dee.greet: SCARLET DEE. I KEEP THE BOOK FOR THE COVE - WHO TIES UP, WHO OWES, WHO'S HANGING ABOUT THE GIBBET LOOKING THOUGHTFUL. WELCOME TO TORTUGA. MIND YOUR PURSE.
dee.again: STILL AFLOAT, CAPTAIN. THE SQUALLS DIDN'T WANT YOU EITHER.

topics.a: HERE. YOUR SHIPS, THE GUNS WE'VE GOT, STORM RIGGING THAT'LL KEEP YOUR MAST IN, HANDS WHO KNOW A CUTLASS FROM A FORK, AND RUM AT A PRICE THAT'LL MAKE YOU SMILE.
THE PIRATES CALL THE TOWN THAT, AFTER A SONG ABOUT A PLACE NOBODY'S EVER BEEN. THE CHART SAYS CINDER KEY, AFTER THE MOUNTAIN. THE MOUNTAIN DOESN'T CARE WHAT ANYONE CALLS IT.
THE NAVY SANK A GALLEON IN THE MOUTH TO SHUT US IN. WE LIVE ON HER NOW - HALF THE TOWN IS HER TIMBERS. THE MAST BY THE PIER WE DON'T TALK ABOUT. THE HULL ON THE BEACH IS VESPER'S SHOP.
UP THE TRAIL BEHIND TOWN. THE CRATER'S HOT, THE GLASS UP THERE SELLS, AND THINGS LIVE IN THE ASH THAT BITE. TAKE A BLADE AND DON'T STAND ON THE BRIGHT BITS.

rook.name: Rook
rook.role: Keeps the Salt Rat, Tortuga's tavern
rook.greet: ...RUM, GROG OR TROUBLE? WE DO ALL THREE. THE THIRD ONE'S FREE BUT YOU PAY FOR THE FURNITURE.
rook.again: YOU AGAIN. SIT WHERE I CAN SEE YOU.

topics.a: BUILT OUT OF THE STERN OF A GALLEON THE NAVY SANK. THE BEAMS ARE HER BEAMS. THE BAR WAS HER CAPTAIN'S TABLE. HE WOULDN'T LIKE WHAT WE DO ON IT.
LOST IT IN A CARD GAME. THE OTHER FELLOW LOST MORE. WE DON'T PLAY CARDS IN HERE NOW. WE PLAY BONES.
OLD WICK UP IN THE STORMWATCH SAYS A BIG BLOW'S COMING. OLD WICK ALWAYS SAYS THAT. ONE DAY HE'LL BE RIGHT AND THEN WE'LL NEVER HEAR THE END OF IT.

wick.name: Old Wick
wick.role: Keeps the stormwatch on Cinder Key
wick.greet: WICK. I WATCH THE WEATHER SO THE PIRATES DON'T HAVE TO. THEY DON'T THANK ME. THE ONES WHO LISTEN COME HOME.
wick.again: GLASS IS MOVING. IT'S ALWAYS MOVING. SIT DOWN.

topics.a: THE BOARD BY THE GLASS SAYS WHAT'S COMING - FOR THE WHOLE SEA, MIND, NOT JUST THIS ROCK. THE CONES ON THE MAST OUTSIDE SAY IT TO ANYONE IN THE COVE WHO CAN'T READ. WHICH IS EVERYONE.

THEY COME UP OUT OF NOTHING. A DARK PATCH ON THE WATER, A CURTAIN OF RAIN, AND THEN THE WIND HITS YOU LIKE A DOOR. IF YOU'RE CARRYING FULL SAIL SHE GOES OVER. REEF EARLY. REEF OFTEN. AND CARRY ONE OF MY GLASSES.

SEALED GLASS, CAMPHOR AND SALTPETRE AND A LITTLE SECRET. IT CLOUDS BEFORE A SQUALL. CARRY ONE AND YOU'LL FEEL THE BLOW COMING - HALF THE DAMAGE IS NOT EXPECTING IT. THE BOARD SELLS THEM; I WROTE THE PRICE ON IT.
ON CRIMSON REACH, UP NORTH. SHE MAKES HER OWN WEATHER. WHEN THE CRATER HERE GLOWS AND THE GLASS DROPS FOR NO REASON, SHE'S AWAKE. I WRITE IT DOWN. NOBODY READS IT.

kettle.name: Ham Kettle
kettle.role: Builds raiders on the pirates' slip, without plans
kettle.greet: HAM KETTLE. I BUILD SHIPS FROM WHAT'S IN MY HEAD AND WHAT'S IN THE COVE. THIS ONE'S GOT THREE GALLEONS IN HER ALREADY AND SHE'S NOT HALF DONE.
kettle.again: MIND THE PITCH. IT REMEMBERS WHO STOOD IN IT.

topics.a: LONG, LOW AND BLACK, TWO MASTS, FOUR GUNS. THE FASTEST THING ON THE SEAS WHEN SHE'S DONE. GARRO ON CRIMSON REACH SELLS THEM IF YOU CAN'T WAIT. I CAN WAIT. I'M VERY GOOD AT IT.

ANY SHIP OF YOURS CAN WEAR THEM. YOUR OWN SLIPWAY'LL PAINT HER WHATEVER YOU LIKE - BLACK HULL, BLACK CLOTH, A SKULL UNDER THE BOWSPRIT. MAKES THE MERCHANTS NERVOUS. MAKES THE NAVY NERVOUS. MAKES ME PROUD.
PLANS ARE FOR PEOPLE WHO EXPECT TO BE INTERRUPTED. NOBODY INTERRUPTS ME. I'VE GOT A POT OF BOILING PITCH.

annis.name: Red Annis
annis.role: Pirate captain, between ships. Plays Bones at the Salt Rat
annis.greet: RED ANNIS. YOU'LL HAVE SEEN MY POSTER - IT'S THE FRAMED ONE. SIT DOWN AND LOSE SOME MONEY.
annis.again: BACK FOR MORE? I LIKE YOU. I'LL STILL TAKE YOUR COINS.

topics.a: CAPTAIN OF THE SCARLET WIDOW TILL THE NAVY TOOK HER OFF ME AT THE TEETH. I'M WAITING FOR A SHIP. SOMEBODY ELSE'S, PROBABLY.

THE CRIMSON'S OURS BECAUSE NOBODY ELSE WANTS IT. THE SQUALLS SCARE THE MERCHANTS AND THE NAVY HATES THE ROCKS. IF YOU SAIL IT, CARRY GUNS, CARRY A STORM GLASS, AND IF A BLACK SAIL HAILS YOU, PAY OR FIGHT. DON'T DITHER. WE HATE DITHERING.
THE GREEN ONE? I SAW HER ONCE, OFF THE MIDNIGHT EDGE, SAILING STRAIGHT INTO THE WIND. MY WHOLE CREW WENT QUIET. I DON'T GO QUIET. I WENT QUIET.

gash.name: Gash
gash.greet: FRESH COINS. LOVELY. SIT DOWN, SIT DOWN.
gash.again: MY FAVOURITE CUSTOMER. MY FAVOURITE PURSE.

topics.a: I DO A BIT OF THIS AND A BIT OF THAT AND A LOT OF BONES. THE RINGS? WON THEM. ALL OF THEM. MOSTLY FAIRLY.
VESPER? UNDER THE HULL ON THE BEACH. ANYTHING HOT YOU TAKE OFF A PIRATE - SILVER, RINGS, THAT CURSED LITTLE IDOL - SHE'LL BUY. THE HONEST LOT WON'T TOUCH IT. MORE FOOL THEM.

tobiah.name: Tobiah Wren
tobiah.greet: ...A WARM ONE. WE DON'T GET MANY. MIND THE PLANKS - SOME OF THEM REMEMBER BEING TREES.
tobiah.again: STILL HERE? SO AM I. SO ARE WE ALL.

topics.a: TOBIAH WREN. I RANG THE BELL FOR SALTMERE FORTY YEARS - WEDDINGS, BURIALS, FOG. THE NIGHT THE SEA CAME UP I RANG IT TILL THE WATER CAME UP THE STAIRS. THEN I KEPT RINGING. I'M NOT SURE I EVER STOPPED.
FIFTY HOUSES AND A CHAPEL. WE FISHED, WE MENDED NETS, WE MARRIED EACH OTHER'S COUSINS. NOW WE WALK THE OLD WAYS AT NIGHT AND THE STREET'S FULL OF SEA. IT'S QUIETER THAN IT WAS. I MISS THE NOISE.
IN THE DARK OF THE MOON IT RINGS ITSELF - OR I RING IT; IT'S HARD TO TELL, NOW. WE RING FOR THE GLOAMING. SHE WENT OUT FOR HELP THAT NIGHT AND NEVER CAME BACK.
SOME OF US WENT DOWN WITH OUR WITS AND SOME DIDN'T. THE ONES WHO DIDN'T COME UP OUT OF THE WATER AT ANYONE WARM. DON'T HOLD IT AGAINST THEM. DO HOLD A SWORD.

marrow.name: Captain Wenna Marrow
marrow.role: Master of the Gloaming. Still steering for home
marrow.greet: STAND BY THE SHEETS. NO - YOU'RE NOT CREW. YOU'RE WARM. HOW DID YOU GET ABOARD? NEVER MIND. HAVE YOU SEEN SALTMERE?
marrow.again: STILL ABOARD? WE'RE CLOSE NOW. WE'RE ALWAYS CLOSE.

topics.a: WENNA MARROW. I'VE HAD THE GLOAMING TWENTY YEARS. WE PUT OUT INTO THE STORM WITH SIX ABOARD FOR THE ABBEY'S BOATS. THE ABBEY WAS ALREADY UNDER. WE TURNED FOR HOME. WE'VE BEEN TURNING FOR HOME EVER SINCE.
I CAN'T SEE THE HARBOUR LIGHT. FIFTY YEARS AND I CAN'T SEE IT. THE MIST, OR THE DARK, OR ME. A SHIP NEEDS A LIGHT TO STEER FOR, AND A LIGHT TO BE SEEN BY.
SIX OF US. FOUR STILL KNOW WHO THEY ARE AND GO ABOUT THEIR WORK. TWO DON'T, AND THEY COME AT ANYONE WARM WITH A CUTLASS. I'M SORRY FOR THAT. KEEP CLEAR OF THE HATCH.

ume.name: Granny Ume
ume.role: Keeps the tea house on Lantern Row
ume.greet: SIT, SIT. NOBODY DRINKS TEA STANDING UP ON MY ROW. YOU'VE COME DOWN OUT OF THE RAIN AND THE NEON - YOU HAVE THE LOOK. GREEN OR MATCHA?
ume.again: BACK AGAIN. GOOD. THE KETTLE KNEW. IT STARTED SINGING BEFORE YOU TURNED THE CORNER.

topics.a: UME. I'VE POURED TEA IN THIS ROOM SINCE BEFORE THE FIRST TOWER WENT UP. THEY BUILT IT RIGHT OVER MY HEAD. I KEPT POURING.
THIS WAS THE WHOLE DISTRICT ONCE. TIMBER AND TILE AND LANTERNS. NOW IT'S ONE STREET THE CITY FORGOT TO KNOCK DOWN. DON'T REMIND IT.
UP THE STEPS AT THE END, ON TOKUDA'S ROOF. KANNA KEEPS IT. RING THE BELL, DRAW A FORTUNE. IF IT'S A BAD ONE, TIE IT TO THE CORD AND LEAVE IT THERE.
HALCYON SENT ANOTHER MAN WITH A CLIPBOARD ABOUT 'REDEVELOPMENT'. HOSHI FED HIM. HE CAME BACK THE NEXT NIGHT, WITHOUT THE CLIPBOARD.

lanternmaker.name: Tokuda the Lantern Maker
lanternmaker.role: Makes the paper lanterns of Lantern Row
lanternmaker.greet: MIND THE GLUE. EVERY LANTERN ON THIS ROW CAME OFF THAT TABLE, ONE RIB AT A TIME. TAKE ONE IF YOU LIKE - THEY'RE FOR GIVING.
lanternmaker.again: AH, THE SKY-CAPTAIN. I'VE SAVED YOU A RED ONE. RED FOR LUCK, AMBER FOR HOME.

topics.a: TOKUDA. MY GRANDFATHER MADE LANTERNS, AND HIS, AND HIS. I'M THE FIRST ONE WHO HAD TO MAKE THEM UNDER A SKY YOU CAN'T SEE.
THE TOWERS HAVE NEON. NEON IS LOUD. A PAPER LANTERN IS QUIET. IT SAYS: SOMEONE LIVES HERE AND THEY'RE STILL UP.
THAT'S MY ROOF THE SHRINE'S ON. MY FATHER LET THE OLD KEEPER PUT IT THERE IN A STORM AND NOBODY EVER MOVED IT. NOBODY WANTS TO.

hoshi.name: Old Hoshi
hoshi.role: Cooks at Hoshi Ramen on Lantern Row
hoshi.greet: SIT. EAT. TALK AFTER. THE BROTH'S BEEN GOING FORTY YEARS AND IT'S NEVER BEEN BETTER THAN TONIGHT.
hoshi.again: YOU AGAIN. GOOD - THE STOOL REMEMBERS YOU. SHOYU?

topics.a: HOSHI. FORTY YEARS AT THIS COUNTER. THE POT'S NEVER GONE COLD. NOT IN THE BROWNOUTS, NOT IN THE FLOOD, NOT WHEN THE LOOP CAME THROUGH.
SOY, BONES, KELP FROM LUMAR WHEN I CAN GET IT, AND WHATEVER WAS IN THE POT YESTERDAY. THE SECRET IS YESTERDAY.
CYBER NOODLES? HER BROTH GLOWS. MINE DOESN'T NEED TO. SHE LEARNED ON THIS STOOL. TELL HER I SAID SO.

keiko.name: Mama Keiko
keiko.role: Owns the Akachochin izakaya on Lantern Row
keiko.greet: IN OR OUT, THE RAIN DOESN'T CARE. THE SAKE'S WARM, THE SKEWERS ARE ON, AND I DON'T SERVE ANYONE WHO TALKS ABOUT WORK.
keiko.again: THE SKY-CAPTAIN. YOUR CRATE'S STILL THERE, NOBODY SITS ON IT BUT YOU.

topics.a: KEIKO. MY MOTHER RAN THIS PLACE AND HER MOTHER BEFORE HER. EVERYONE CALLS ME MAMA. EVEN MAMA DID.
THE FREIGHTER CREWS COME UP THE STREET WHEN THEY BERTH. THEY DRINK WHAT I POUR AND PAY IN WHATEVER THEY'VE GOT. I'VE A JAR OF COINS FROM NINE WORLDS.
DESH OFF THE OLD MERCY IS LOOKING FOR CREW AGAIN. SHE ALWAYS IS. NOBODY STAYS ON THAT SHIP AND NOBODY KNOWS WHY THEY LEAVE.

kanna.name: Kanna
kanna.role: Keeps the shrine on Lantern Row's roofs
kanna.greet: WELCOME UP. MIND THE GRAVEL - I'VE JUST RAKED IT. RING THE BELL TO SAY YOU'RE HERE, AND DRAW A FORTUNE IF YOU DARE.
kanna.again: BACK UP THE STEPS. THE FOXES SAID YOU'D COME.

topics.a: KANNA. MY GRANDMOTHER KEPT THE SHRINE AND I KEEP IT NOW. I SWEEP, I LIGHT THE LANTERNS, I LISTEN. PEOPLE TELL A SHRINE THINGS THEY DON'T TELL EACH OTHER.
INARI'S MESSENGERS. THEY KEEP AN EYE ON THE ROW. AND ON THE TOWERS, WHICH I THINK WORRIES THEM MORE.
A COIN IN THE BOX, RING THE BELL, DRAW A SLIP. GREAT BLESSING, BLESSING, SMALL BLESSING, OR A CURSE. A CURSE YOU TIE TO THE CORD AND WALK AWAY FROM.
THE LOOP GOES BY AT EYE LEVEL UP HERE. AT NIGHT EVERY WINDOW'S LIT AND YOU CAN SEE THE PEOPLE IN THEM. SOME OF THEM WAVE.

halloran.name: Inspector Halloran
halloran.greet: ARMS OUT. HOLD STILL. NOTHING? NOTHING. YOU'D BE AMAZED WHAT PEOPLE TRY TO WALK THROUGH THIS ARCH. MOSTLY SPORES. ONCE A GOAT.
halloran.again: YOU AGAIN. STILL CLEAN. I'M ALMOST DISAPPOINTED.

topics.a: HALLORAN, ARCADIA CUSTOMS. TWENTY-TWO YEARS ON THIS ARCH. I'VE CONFISCATED NINE PLANETS' WORTH OF CONTRABAND AND I KEEP THE BEST OF IT IN A DRAWER I'M NOT ALLOWED TO OPEN.
THE OLD MERCY, HAULING. THE HALCYON IX, HALCYON'S - DON'T TOUCH, DON'T LOOK. THE SLOW HAZARD, WHO KNOWS. NOBODY'S EVER DECLARED A THING OFF HER.
THE BIG LIFT. GOES ALL THE WAY UP TO THE SPIRES AND ALL THE WAY DOWN TO THE PLACES WE DON'T TALK ABOUT. FREIGHT GOES DOWN. THINGS COME UP. I DON'T INSPECT WHAT COMES UP.

brannigan.name: Brannigan
brannigan.role: Keeps the Last Burn, the spacers' bar
brannigan.greet: WELCOME TO THE LAST BURN. LAST THING YOU DO BEFORE YOU LEAVE A PLANET, FIRST THING YOU DO WHEN YOU GET BACK. REACTOR STOUT'S ON. DON'T ASK WHAT'S IN IT.
brannigan.again: THE SKY-CAPTAIN. YOUR MUG'S ON THE HOOK - THE ONE WITH THE DENT.

topics.a: BRANNIGAN. FLEW HAULERS THIRTY YEARS TILL A REACTOR TOOK MY ARM. GOT A CHROME ONE AND A BAR. THE BAR'S THE BETTER DEAL.
CHROME CLINIC ON THE STREET DID IT, BACK WHEN THEY STILL DID IT CHEAP. NOW YOU WANT GOOD CHROME YOU GO UP TO THE SPIRES AND PAY FOR THE NAME.
THE SLOW HAZARD COMES IN EMPTY AND GOES OUT HEAVY, AND HER CREW DRINK HERE AND NEVER SAY A WORD. I DON'T ASK. YOU SHOULDN'T EITHER.

desh.name: Captain Desh
desh.role: Captain of the Old Mercy, a bulk hauler
desh.greet: FORTY-ONE, FORTY-TWO - YOU MADE ME LOSE COUNT. DESH, OLD MERCY. IF YOU'RE HERE ABOUT THE CREW JOB, YOU'RE HIRED. IF YOU'RE NOT, YOU'RE STILL HIRED.
desh.again: BACK FOR THE JOB? NO? THE OFFER STANDS. IT ALWAYS STANDS.

topics.a: DESH. I'VE RUN THE OLD MERCY BETWEEN LUMAR, ENIGMA AND HERE FOR NINETEEN YEARS. SHE'S HELD TOGETHER WITH PATCHES AND SPITE AND SHE'S NEVER MISSED A BERTH.
SALT FISH AND SPORE-LAMP OIL OUT, CHROME AND CIRCUIT IN. LUMAR PAYS IN FISH, ARCADIA PAYS IN CREDIT, ENIGMA DOESN'T PAY AT ALL, THEY JUST WAVE.
THEY LEAVE. EVERY ONE OF THEM, AFTER A RUN OR TWO. THEY SAY SHE HUMS AT NIGHT. SHE DOES. I LIKE IT.

nadia.name: Nadia Voss
nadia.greet: CIRRUS. THE HIGHEST BAR YOU CAN GET INTO WITHOUT A NAME ON A LIST. WHAT ARE WE CELEBRATING?
nadia.again: BACK FOR THE SOUR? EVERYONE COMES BACK FOR THE SOUR.

topics.a: I POURED IN THE DISTRICT TEN YEARS. CLUB VOID, A PLACE THAT ISN'T THERE ANY MORE, A NOODLE BAR THAT SOLD BEER IF YOU ASKED NICELY. UP HERE THEY TIP IN SPIRES MONEY AND COMPLAIN ABOUT THE ICE. I LIKE IT BETTER DOWN THERE. I EARN MORE UP HERE.

ROUND, SO NOBODY GETS THE BAD SEAT. THE TOWER IN THE MIDDLE IS MY BACK BAR; THE SIGN IS PINK BECAUSE THE OWNER'S WIFE LIKED PINK. THE SOUR'S MINE. THE SPRITZ IS FOR PEOPLE WHO WANT TO HOLD SOMETHING PRETTY.

THE CHAMPAGNE BAR UP IN THE SPIRES POACHED MY LAST BARBACK. THEY GAVE HIM A WHITE JACKET AND A NEW NAME. HE STILL SENDS ME POSTCARDS OF THE STARS. YOU CAN'T SEE THEM FROM HERE - THE SMOG'S IN THE WAY.
THE TRAIN GOES ROUND EVERY TWELVE MINUTES. THE LAST ONE OF THE NIGHT IS ALWAYS FULL OF PEOPLE WHO MISSED THE ONE BEFORE. I CAN SET MY CLOCK BY THE RUMBLE.

bastien.name: Chef Bastien
bastien.greet: YOU'RE STANDING IN THE SMOKE. GOOD. THAT'S WHERE THE FLAVOUR IS.

topics.a: BASTIEN. I COOKED ON A FREIGHTER FOR SIX YEARS - THE SPACEPORT DOWN IN THE DISTRICT, THEN EVERYWHERE. A GRILL IS A GRILL. UP HERE THE WIND TAKES THE SMOKE OFF OVER THE EDGE AND SOMEWHERE A THOUSAND FEET DOWN SOMEONE GETS HUNGRY.

VAT BEEF, GROWN IN THE UNDERCITY, AND DON'T MAKE THAT FACE - IT'S GOOD BEEF. THE SALT COMES FROM LUMAR, OFF A HARBOUR CALLED DIGGEN'S POINT. SEA SALT FROM ANOTHER WORLD. THEY CHARGE MORE FOR THE SALT THAN THE STEAK.
LUMEN'S HIRO AND I HAVE A BET ON WHO SELLS MORE SKEWERS BY THE END OF THE YEAR. HE'S WINNING. DON'T TELL HIM I SAID.

hiro.name: Hiro Tanabe
hiro.greet: IRASSHAI. SIT, SIT. THE SAKE IS WARM AND THE COALS ARE WHITE.

topics.a: MY FATHER HAD A STALL ON LANTERN ROW, DOWN IN THE OLD QUARTER. SAME TARE - HE STARTED IT THIRTY YEARS AGO AND I'VE ADDED TO IT EVERY NIGHT SINCE. THE POT IS OLDER THAN THIS TOWER.
BINCHOTAN - WHITE CHARCOAL. NO FLAME, JUST HEAT. YOU TURN THEM WHEN THEY TELL YOU. THEY TELL YOU WITH A SOUND.
BASTIEN THINKS WE HAVE A BET. WE DO NOT HAVE A BET. I AM SIMPLY WINNING.

dove.name: Dove Okafor-Reyes
dove.greet: NEED A LIFT? I DO SKYPORT, THE SPIRES, THE SPACEPORT, ANYWHERE WITH A PAD AND A REASON.

topics.a: TWENTY YEARS IN THE LANES. I KNOW EVERY TOWER BY ITS LIGHTS. YOU KNOW YOU'RE IN THE SPIRES WHEN THE NEON GOES PASTEL AND THE PASSENGERS STOP SAYING THANK YOU.
THE TRAFFIC RUNS IN RIVERS BETWEEN THE TOWERS - EAST ON THE TOP LANE, WEST UNDER IT. POLICE CUT ACROSS WHEREVER THEY LIKE. ABOVE THE SMOG IT'S QUIET. TOO QUIET. I DON'T TRUST QUIET.
SOMEONE UP IN THE SPIRES HAS A YACHT THAT CAN FLY. ACTUALLY FLY. KEEPS IT AT THE SKY DOCKS. I'VE SEEN IT GO OUT ONCE, LIT UP LIKE A CHANDELIER, NOBODY AT THE WHEEL.

liftman.name: Augustin
liftman.role: Lift attendant, the Terraces express lobby
liftman.greet: GOOD EVENING. THE SPIRE EXPRESS GOES UP TO FOUR HUNDRED AND EIGHTY. THE CORE EXPRESS GOES - WELL. EVERYWHERE.

topics.a: AUGUSTIN. FORTY-ONE YEARS IN THIS LOBBY. I HAVE PRESSED THE BUTTON FOR TWO MAYORS, A DUCHESS AND A MAN WHO SAID HE WAS A GOD. THE GOD TIPPED THE WORST.
THE SPIRE EXPRESS CLIMBS TWO HUNDRED AND EIGHTY FLOORS IN NINETY SECONDS. YOUR EARS WILL POP AT THE SMOG LINE. WHEN THE DOORS OPEN, LOOK UP. YOU'LL SEE STARS. REAL ONES.
THE CORE EXPRESS GOES DOWN THROUGH THE DISTRICT AND KEEPS GOING. I HAVE NEVER TAKEN IT BELOW THE STREET. I HAVE A WIFE.

odette.name: Odette Lark
odette.greet: CAREFUL, HONEY. YOU WALKED IN DURING THE QUIET PART. EVERYBODY HEARD YOUR SHOES.
odette.again: YOU CAME BACK. THEY ALWAYS COME BACK FOR THE SECOND SET.

topics.a: I SANG MY FIRST NIGHT HERE AT NINETEEN IN THIS SAME DRESS. THEY'VE LET THE DRESS OUT TWICE AND MY FEE UP FOUR TIMES. THE SPIRES KEEP ASKING ME TO SING AT THE OPERA. I KEEP SAYING THE OPERA CAN COME DOWN HERE.

RAY ON THE PIANO - HE TAUGHT ME TO WAIT A BEAT. MINGO ON THE BASS, WHO HASN'T SPOKEN A FULL SENTENCE SINCE I'VE KNOWN HIM AND DOESN'T NEED TO. LOU-LOU ON THE DRUMS. SHE'S THE ONLY ONE OF US UNDER FIFTY AND SHE KEEPS US HONEST.
THE WINDOW. THAT'S THE WHOLE REASON. THE MOON SITS IN THE SMOG RIGHT THERE BEHIND ME ON A CLEAR NIGHT AND I SING TO IT AND IT DOESN'T SING BACK. BEST AUDIENCE I EVER HAD.
LADY VELVET AT THE ROYALE AND I CAME UP TOGETHER. WE DON'T SPEAK. WE SEND EACH OTHER FLOWERS ON OPENING NIGHTS WITH NO CARD. EVERYBODY KNOWS WHO THEY'RE FROM.

ray.name: Ray Delacroix
ray.greet: MM. ONE MORE CHORUS AND I'M ALL YOURS.
ray.again: STILL HERE? GOOD. THIS NEXT ONE'S FOR THE PEOPLE STILL HERE.

topics.a: I'VE PLAYED THIS PIANO LONGER THAN THE TOWER'S HAD ITS NAME. IT USED TO BE THE HALBERD BUILDING. BEFORE THAT IT WAS A HOLE IN THE AIR. I PLAYED THE HOLE TOO.
I QUIT THIRTY YEARS AGO. THE CIGARETTE DIDN'T. IT LIKES IT HERE.

mingo.name: Mingo
mingo.greet: MINGO NODS. THE BASS SAYS HELLO FOR HIM.
mingo.again: MINGO NODS AGAIN, A LITTLE WARMER.

topics.a: ...BASS.
ODETTE SINGS. RAY THINKS. LOU-LOU DRIVES. I HOLD THE FLOOR UP. ...GOOD BAND.

sol.name: Sol Achebe
sol.greet: EVENING. KEEP YOUR VOICE DOWN AND YOUR GLASS UP AND WE'LL GET ALONG FINE.
sol.again: OLD FASHIONED? STIRRED FOR THE LENGTH OF A BALLAD. IT'S A RULE.

topics.a: SOL. I TEND BAR LIKE RAY PLAYS PIANO - SLOW, AND ONLY WHAT'S NEEDED. THE BLUE NOTE'S MINE. IT TASTES THE WAY THE LAST SONG OF THE NIGHT SOUNDS.
NO SCREENS IN HERE. NO HOLO-ADS. THE OWNERS TRIED ONCE; ODETTE STOPPED SINGING UNTIL THEY TOOK IT DOWN. TOOK FOUR NIGHTS. FULLEST FOUR NIGHTS WE EVER HAD.
THERE'S A MEMBERS' CLUB UP IN THE SPIRES WITH A JAZZ ROOM NOBODY'S PLAYED IN FOR YEARS. THEY'VE OFFERED ODETTE A FORTUNE. SHE SENDS THEIR LETTERS BACK WITH A LIPSTICK KISS ON THEM.

iris.name: Iris Vance
iris.greet: WELCOME TO THE ATRIUM, L200. HOW CAN I HELP YOU FIND YOUR WAY?
iris.again: LOST AGAIN? IT'S A BIG CITY. IT'S ALL I THINK ABOUT.

topics.a: THE LOOP TAKES YOU ROUND THE RING - LANTERN ROW, THE SPACEPORT, BACK HERE. THE SPIRE EXPRESS IN THE LOBBY OUTSIDE GOES UP TO THE SPIRES. THE CORE EXPRESS GOES DOWN, ALL THE WAY. AND THE CABS ON THE PAD GO ANYWHERE WITH A PAD.
THE STREET IS LEVEL ZERO. WE'RE TWO HUNDRED UP. THE SPIRES ARE FOUR-EIGHTY, ABOVE THE SMOG. BELOW THE STREET, THE UNDERCITY, AND BELOW THAT THE SUMP. THE MONEY GOES UP. THE WATER GOES DOWN.
FORTY FLOORS OF SHOPS AROUND ONE EMPTY MIDDLE. THE CHANDELIER IS NINE HUNDRED RODS OF LIGHT; A MAN COMES ONCE A MONTH TO REPLACE THE ONE THAT WENT OUT. HE NEVER FINDS IT. HE CHANGES ONE ANYWAY.
THE SPIRES HAVE A CHROME BOUTIQUE NOW - DESIGNER IMPLANTS, GOLD-LEAF CIRCUITRY. THEY'RE TALKING ABOUT OPENING A BRANCH DOWN HERE. THE SHUTTERED SHOP AT THE END. WE'LL SEE.

clemence.name: Clémence
clemence.greet: GOOD EVENING. A TABLE UNDER THE WISTERIA? THE JASMINE PEARLS OPEN BEST IF YOU WATCH THEM. NOBODY IS IN A HURRY UP HERE.
clemence.again: BACK FOR ANOTHER POT. I KEPT YOUR CUP WARM. METAPHORICALLY. HALCYON WOULD BILL ME FOR THE HEAT.

topics.a: I GREW UP SIXTY FLOORS UNDER THE STREET, WHERE TEA COMES IN A BRICK AND TASTES OF THE PIPE IT CAME THROUGH. I SAVED FOR NINE YEARS FOR A LIFT PASS. I WAS GOING TO LOOK AT THE STARS ONCE AND GO HOME. THAT WAS TWELVE YEARS AGO.
REAL LEAVES, GROWN ON VERDANCE AND SHIPPED UP IN CEDAR BOXES. THE PETIT FOURS ARE MINE. THE HONEY CAKE IS A BRAMBLEFORD RECIPE - DON'T TELL THE GUESTS, THEY THINK IT'S FRENCH.
THE ONLY PLACE IN ARCADIA ABOVE THE SMOG. THE ONLY PLACE WITH REAL STARS. PEOPLE UP HERE STOP NOTICING THEM AFTER A MONTH. I STILL LOOK EVERY NIGHT BEFORE I LOCK UP.
THE YACHT AT THE DOCKS BELONGS TO SOMEBODY WHO HAS NEVER ONCE STEPPED OFF IT. THE STEWARD COMES UP FOR MACARONS. HE SAYS SHE'S WAITING FOR SOMEONE. THEY ALWAYS ARE.

ferris.name: Old Ferris
ferris.greet: MIND THE LAWN. EVERY BLADE OF IT CAME UP IN THE LIFT IN A SEED TRAY ON MY KNEES.
ferris.again: STILL HERE? GOOD. THE TREES LIKE COMPANY. THEY DON'T GET MUCH WIND UP HERE.

topics.a: FORTY YEARS KEEPING THESE GARDENS. BEFORE THAT I GREW MUSHROOMS IN THE SUMP UNDER A LAMP. I KNOW BOTH ENDS OF THIS CITY. THE ROOTS ARE THE SAME.

REAL ONES. CHERRY, LIME, A PEAR THAT SULKS. THEY THINK THE STARS ARE THE SUN. I DON'T CORRECT THEM. THE BLOSSOM COMES IN SPITE OF EVERYTHING, AND THAT'S MORE THAN YOU CAN SAY FOR MOST OF THE PEOPLE WHO WALK UNDER IT.
THE ONLY WATER IN ARCADIA THAT SHOWS THE STARS. THE CHILDREN COUNT THEM. NOBODY'S EVER GOT THE SAME ANSWER TWICE.
HALCYON WANTS THE GARDENS FOR ANOTHER DOCK. EVERY YEAR THEY ASK, AND EVERY YEAR THE OLD LADY IN THE ORRERY SAYS NO. NOBODY KNOWS WHO SHE IS. I WATER HER ROSES.

aurelio.name: Aurelio
aurelio.greet: GOOD EVENING. HALCYON TOWER RECEIVES BY APPOINTMENT. YOU HAVE NO APPOINTMENT. NEVERTHELESS - GOOD EVENING.
aurelio.again: STILL NO APPOINTMENT. STILL GOOD EVENING.

topics.a: THE COMPANY THAT OWNS THE LIGHT. THE TOWERS, THE SCREENS, THE AIR UP HERE. MOST OF THE LIFTS. WHAT IT DOESN'T OWN IT IS USUALLY IN THE PROCESS OF ASKING ABOUT.

THE SPIRE EXPRESS TAKES YOU DOWN TO THE TERRACES. THE CORE EXPRESS GOES ALL THE WAY DOWN, FURTHER THAN MOST GUESTS CARE TO. THE AIR CABS ARE ON THE DOCKS. THE LOOP IS BELOW US, ROUND THE MID-LEVELS - WE HEAR IT, ON QUIET NIGHTS, LIKE THE SEA.
A PRIVATE CLUB. I AM NOT PERMITTED TO SAY WHO ITS MEMBERS ARE. I AM NOT PERMITTED TO SAY THAT I AM NOT PERMITTED. KNOCK, IF YOU LIKE. MR ASHDOWN WILL DECIDE.
SOMEBODY ON THE BOARD HAS NEW EYES FROM LUMEN. THEY CAN SEE IN THE DARK AND THEY STILL CAN'T SEE WHY NOBODY LIKES THEM.

harlan.name: Harlan Quay
harlan.greet: SKY DOCKS. YACHTS, CABS, THE ODD PRIVATE SHUTTLE THAT THINKS IT'S A YACHT. STAND BEHIND THE GOLD LINE, THE LIFT FIELDS TICKLE.
harlan.again: BACK AGAIN. THE CABS RUN ALL NIGHT. THE YACHT DOESN'T RUN AT ALL.

topics.a: THE PAD BY THE SIGN. A CAB WILL TAKE YOU TO ANY PAD IN THE CITY - THE TERRACES, SKYPORT 7, THE SPACEPORT DOWN ON THE STREET. DEAR, BUT YOU GET THE VIEW FOR NOTHING.
BERTHED HERE SIX YEARS. NEVER SAILED. OWNER NEVER COMES ASHORE. STEWARD PAYS THE BERTH IN GOLD COINS THAT ARE OLDER THAN THE CITY. I DON'T ASK. THE COINS DON'T ASK EITHER.
I RAN FREIGHTERS INTO THE SPACEPORT FOR TWENTY YEARS, DOWN IN THE RAIN. NOW I WATCH RICH PEOPLE PARK. THE PAY'S BETTER. THE STORIES ARE WORSE.
THE SMOG WAS THIN LAST WEEK - YOU COULD SEE THE LOOP'S LIGHTS GOING ROUND, AND UNDER THAT THE STREET. ONE OF THE MEMBERS FAINTED. SAID IT WAS THE HEIGHT. IT WASN'T THE HEIGHT.

coco.name: Coco
coco.greet: WELCOME TO AURELLE. THE HIGHEST BAR IN ARCADIA, IF YOU DON'T COUNT HALCYON'S PRIVATE ONE, AND NOBODY'S ALLOWED TO. A STARLIGHT? IT GLITTERS. ON PURPOSE.
coco.again: THE USUAL? YOU HAVE A USUAL NOW. THAT'S HOW IT STARTS.

topics.a: I MIXED DRINKS AT CLUB VOID FOR SIX YEARS. THEN SOMEBODY FROM UP HERE TASTED ONE AND HIRED ME ON THE SPOT. I STILL PUT A PINCH OF VOID FIZZ IN THE STARLIGHT. DON'T TELL BASTIEN.
CHAMPAGNE OVER A VIOLET LIQUEUR WITH SILVER IN IT. IT CATCHES THE REAL STARS THROUGH THE GLASS. DOWN BELOW THEY'D NEVER SEE IT SPARKLE - THE SMOG EATS THE LIGHT.
THE SOFAS BY THE GLASS. PEOPLE SIT THERE FOR HOURS LOOKING AT THE SMOG SEA. ONE OLD MAN COMES EVERY NIGHT AND WAVES AT SOMETHING DOWN THERE. I'VE NEVER ASKED WHAT.
THE STEWARD OFF THE LUMIERE BUYS A BOTTLE OF THE '41 EVERY NIGHT AND CARRIES IT BACK UNOPENED. SIX YEARS OF UNOPENED BOTTLES. THERE'S A PARTY WAITING ON THAT YACHT.

bastien_sommelier.name: Bastien
bastien_sommelier.greet: GOOD EVENING. THE CELLAR IS SEVEN HUNDRED FLOORS BELOW US AND THE BOTTLES COME UP IN THEIR OWN LIFT. MAY I SUGGEST SOMETHING THAT HAS TRAVELLED FURTHER THAN YOU?
bastien_sommelier.again: AH. YOU AGAIN. I'VE BEEN SAVING SOMETHING.

topics.a: VINES DON'T GROW IN ARCADIA. EVERY BOTTLE IS FROM OFF-WORLD - VERDANCE'S HILL VINEYARDS, MOSTLY, AND A FEW CASES FROM A ROSE ISLAND THAT SHOULDN'T EXIST. THEY COME IN AT THE SPACEPORT AND UP THE CORE EXPRESS LIKE ROYALTY.
MY FATHER SOLD WINE OFF A CART IN THE UNDERCITY. IT WAS MOSTLY RUST. HE COULD STILL TELL YOU WHICH RUST. I LEARNED FROM HIM.
THE ORRERY ORDERED A CASE OF SOMETHING NOBODY HAS DRUNK IN A HUNDRED YEARS. THE MEMBER WHO ORDERED IT HAS BEEN DEAD FOR FIFTY. MR ASHDOWN SIGNED FOR IT WITHOUT BLINKING.

ashdown.name: Mr Ashdown
ashdown.greet: WELCOME TO THE ORRERY. MEMBERS MAY SIT WHERE THEY LIKE, EXCEPT IN SIR AUGUSTIN'S CHAIR, WHICH IS SIR AUGUSTIN.
ashdown.again: GOOD EVENING. YOUR CHAIR IS WHERE YOU LEFT IT. EVERYTHING HERE IS.

topics.a: FOUNDED BEFORE THE TOWERS, WHEN THIS WAS A HILL AND THE CITY WAS A HARBOUR. THE MEMBERS MOVED IT UP A FLOOR EVERY TIME THE SMOG ROSE. WE ARE NOW, BY MY COUNT, FOUR HUNDRED AND EIGHTY FLOORS UP AND STILL MOVING.

SEVEN WORLDS ROUND A SUN. A MEMBER MADE IT FROM A SHIP'S CHART LONG AGO - A SHIP THAT CAME AND WENT LIKE A RUMOUR. IT HAS SEVEN ARMS. YOUR SHIP, I BELIEVE, KNOWS SEVEN WORLDS. A COINCIDENCE, I'M SURE.
LADY PERPETUA OWNS THE AIR ABOVE THE EASTERN DOCKS. SIR AUGUSTIN OWNED THE SMOG, BRIEFLY, AND SOLD IT BACK TO HALCYON AT A PROFIT. THE REST ARE DISCREET. YOU WILL BE TOO.
I HEAR EVERYTHING. I REPEAT NOTHING. ASK LADY PERPETUA - SHE HEARS LESS AND REPEATS MORE.

perpetua.name: Lady Perpetua
perpetua.greet: SIT, DARLING, YOU'RE BLOCKING THE STARS. DO YOU PLAY? NO? GOOD. I CHEAT, AND IT'S SO TIRESOME WHEN PEOPLE NOTICE.
perpetua.again: BACK FOR MORE GOSSIP. I THOUGHT YOU MIGHT BE.

topics.a: HALCYON IS BUILDING A NEW SPIRE TALLER THAN THIS ONE. THE OLD ONES ARE FURIOUS. THE STARS, I'M TOLD, HAVE NOT BEEN CONSULTED.
I WENT DOWN ONCE, AS A GIRL. ALL THE WAY TO THE STREET. IT WAS RAINING AND A NOODLE MAN GAVE ME A BOWL FOR NOTHING BECAUSE I LOOKED SO LOST. I'VE NEVER EATEN ANYTHING SO GOOD. DON'T TELL ANYONE.
WE WERE AT SCHOOL TOGETHER. SHE CHEATED AT CARDS EVEN THEN. SHE'S THE ONLY PERSON IN ARCADIA I'VE NEVER BEATEN.

augustin.name: Sir Augustin
augustin.greet: HM? OH. ANOTHER NEW ONE. WELCOME. DON'T WAKE ME UNLESS THE SMOG CLEARS.
augustin.again: STILL HERE? SO AM I. IT'S A LIFE.

topics.a: I OWNED IT, YOU KNOW. ALL OF IT. BOUGHT IT FOR A SONG WHEN NOBODY THOUGHT AIR COULD BE OWNED. SOLD IT TO HALCYON FOR A FORTUNE. BEST AND WORST THING I EVER DID. MOSTLY WORST.
NINETY-SIX. I'VE BEEN A MEMBER SINCE I WAS TWELVE. MY FATHER PUT MY NAME DOWN AT BIRTH AND I HAD TO WAIT. I'M STILL WAITING FOR SOMETHING, BUT I'VE FORGOTTEN WHAT.

iris_kade.name: Iris Kade
iris_kade.greet: WELCOME TO LUMEN. EVERYTHING HERE IS MADE FOR ONE PERSON AND WORN BY ONE PERSON. THE CLINICS BELOW FIT PARTS. I FIT PEOPLE.
iris_kade.again: BACK. GOOD. I'VE BEEN THINKING ABOUT YOUR HANDS.

topics.a: I TRAINED IN A CHROME SHOP UNDER THE STREET, WHERE THE ARMS COME OUT OF A BIN AND YOU HOPE. THEN AT THE CHROME CLINIC, WHERE THEY COME OUT OF A BOX AND YOU'RE SURE. HERE THEY COME OUT OF ME.
EYES THAT SEE THE STARS THROUGH ANY SMOG. LACE OF CHROME UNDER THE SKIN. A VOICE TUNED BY THE LYRA'S COACH. A HALO THAT KEEPS TIME WITH YOUR HEART. NOTHING HERE GLITCHES. THAT'S THE WHOLE POINT.
BACK-ALLEY CHROME IN THE UNDERCITY IS BRAVE AND CHEAP AND NOW AND THEN IT BITES. THE CLINIC ON THE STREET IS HONEST. WE'RE NEITHER BRAVE NOR CHEAP. WE'RE PERFECT. AND WE CHARGE FOR IT.
A MEMBER OF HALCYON'S BOARD HAS MY STARLIGHT OPTICS. HE CAN SEE IN THE DARK NOW. HE SAYS IT'S MADE THE BOARD MEETINGS UNBEARABLE.

nox.name: Nox
nox.greet: HI. DON'T TOUCH THE CASES - THEY KNOW. I MEAN THAT LITERALLY.
nox.again: OH, HEY. STILL BROWSING? IRIS LIKES BROWSERS. THEY BECOME BUYERS.

topics.a: IRIS FOUND ME IN THE BACKS BEHIND THE NEON STREET WITH A BUSTED EYE AND FIXED IT FOR NOTHING. NOW I DUST HALOS. IT'S A GOOD LIFE. THE EYE SEES ULTRAVIOLET, WHICH MAKES THE MEMBERS' TEETH LOOK HILARIOUS.
IF YOU HAVE TO ASK... NO, I'LL TELL YOU, IRIS HATES IT WHEN I DO THAT BIT. MORE THAN A SLOOP. LESS THAN A YACHT. ABOUT A HALCYON EXECUTIVE'S LUNCH.

tobias.name: Tobias
tobias.greet: GOOD EVENING. THE STALLS ARE FULL - THEY'RE ALWAYS FULL - BUT THERE'S A BOX UP THE STAIR WITH NOBODY IN IT. THERE USUALLY IS. HALCYON PAYS FOR IT AND NEVER COMES.
tobias.again: BACK FOR THE NEXT ACT? THE BOX IS STILL EMPTY.

topics.a: "STARFALL". THE LAST STAR IN THE SKY FALLS IN LOVE WITH A CITY THAT CAN'T SEE HER. IT ENDS BADLY. THE AUDIENCE WEEPS AND THEN GOES TO AURELLE. EVERY NIGHT.
I SNUCK IN THROUGH THE STAGE DOOR WHEN I WAS NINE AND HID IN A BOX FOR THE WHOLE OF THE SECOND ACT. THEY CAUGHT ME AT THE INTERVAL AND GAVE ME A JOB. I'VE NEVER LEFT.
SERAPHINE HIT A NOTE LAST WEEK THAT CRACKED A FLUTE AT AURELLE, ACROSS THE PLAZA. THEY'VE FRAMED THE PIECES.

fleur.name: Madame Fleur
fleur.greet: TICKETS ARE SOLD OUT UNTIL NEXT SEASON. THE SEASON AFTER THAT IS ALSO SOLD OUT. TOBIAS MAY HAVE A BOX. TOBIAS ALWAYS HAS A BOX. I HAVE GIVEN UP ASKING HOW.

topics.a: THREE THOUSAND SEATS, FOUR TIERS OF BOXES, A CHANDELIER THAT WEIGHS AS MUCH AS A LOOP CARRIAGE. BUILT BY THE FIRST HALCYON FOR HIS WIFE, WHO COULDN'T SING. SHE SANG HERE ANYWAY. NOBODY SAID A WORD.
NEXT SEASON IS A NEW PIECE ABOUT A DROWNED BELL ON A WORLD OF SEAS. THE COMPOSER SAYS HE DREAMED IT. I SAY HE READ IT SOMEWHERE.

seraphine.name: Seraphine Lune
seraphine.greet: A PROGRAMME? OF COURSE, DARLING. WHO SHALL I MAKE IT OUT TO? ... HOW UNUSUAL. I'LL WRITE IT IN GOLD.
seraphine.again: YOU AGAIN! EITHER YOU LOVE THE OPERA OR YOU'RE AFTER ANOTHER PROGRAMME. BOTH ARE ACCEPTABLE.

topics.a: I WAS BORN IN THE SUMP, WHERE THE WATER ECHOES. I SANG TO THE PIPES UNTIL THE PIPES SANG BACK. A TALENT SCOUT HEARD ME THROUGH A GRATING. NOW I SING TO THREE THOUSAND PEOPLE WHO'VE NEVER HEARD WATER ECHO. THEY THINK IT'S ART.
I PLAY THE LAST STAR. I FALL IN THE THIRD ACT. EVERY NIGHT I LOOK OUT FROM THE STAGE AND THINK OF ALL THE PEOPLE BELOW THE SMOG WHO'VE NEVER SEEN ONE. I SING THE FALL FOR THEM.
LADY VELVET AT THE NEON ROYALE AND I WERE ONCE THE SAME GIRL IN THE SAME CHORUS. SHE WENT DOWN; I CAME UP. WE WRITE EVERY MONTH. SHE ALWAYS SAYS SHE HAS THE BETTER AUDIENCE. SHE'S RIGHT.

cliff_marina.name: Marina Sklavou
cliff_marina.role: Keeps the fish taverna on Lanternfall's old port
cliff_marina.greet: SIT, SIT. THE BOATS CAME IN AN HOUR AGO - WHATEVER YOU EAT TONIGHT WAS SWIMMING AT TEATIME.
cliff_marina.again: BACK DOWN ALL THOSE STEPS FOR MY OCTOPUS? I KNEW YOU WOULD.

topics.a: MY FATHER HUNG THE OCTOPUS ON THAT LINE TO DRY, AND HIS FATHER BEFORE HIM. THE VINE OVER THE TABLES IS OLDER THAN ALL OF US. SIT UNDER IT AND I'LL BRING YOU WHAT'S GOOD. PRESS ON THE TABLES - THE MENU'S THERE.
UP THERE IS THE TOWN - WHITE HOUSES, BLUE DOMES, A CHURCH FOR EVERY FAMILY THAT EVER HAD A QUARREL. DOWN HERE IS THE PORT. THE TOWN EATS WHAT THE PORT CATCHES AND COMPLAINS ABOUT THE STEPS.
EVERY TURN OF THE ZIGZAG HAS ITS LAMP. MY GRANDMOTHER SAID THEY'RE FOR THE SAILORS, SO THEY CAN FIND THE WAY UP DRUNK. MY GRANDFATHER SAID THEY'RE FOR THE WIVES, SO THEY CAN SEE THEM COMING.
THE ISLET OUT THERE GLOWED BRIGHTER LAST MONTH. FATHER ILIAS RANG THE BELL ALL NIGHT. NOTHING HAPPENED. HE SAYS THAT MEANS IT WORKED.

cliff_yannis.name: Yannis
cliff_yannis.role: Keeps the donkeys at the foot of the zigzag
cliff_yannis.greet: UP? FIVE COINS AND STAMATIA TAKES YOU TO THE TOP. SHE KNOWS EVERY STEP. SHE HAS OPINIONS ABOUT MOST OF THEM.
cliff_yannis.again: AH, THE SKY CAPTAIN. STAMATIA REMEMBERS YOU. SHE DOESN'T SAY WHETHER SHE'S PLEASED.

topics.a: STAMATIA, ZOE AND LITTLE PERICLES. FIVE COINS UP OR DOWN - PRESS ON THEM. MY COUSIN WAITS AT THE TOP WITH THREE MORE. IF YOU WALK IT, COUNT THE STEPS. NOBODY EVER GETS THE SAME NUMBER TWICE.
BUILT BY THE FIRST SETTLERS, WHO CARRIED EVERY STONE UP ON THEIR BACKS BECAUSE THE DONKEYS HADN'T BEEN INVENTED YET. THAT'S WHAT MY FATHER SAID. I WAS NINE BEFORE I CHECKED.
THEY SAY SAPPHIRE PORT'S FLOATING MARKET PAYS DOUBLE FOR WHAT YOU FISH OUT OF THE CALDERA. THEY SAY A LOT OF THINGS IN SAPPHIRE PORT.

cliff_despina.name: Despina Roussou
cliff_despina.role: Keeps the taverna on the rim
cliff_despina.greet: WELCOME TO THE BEST TABLE ON THE FIVE SEAS. DON'T ARGUE - SIT AND LOOK, THEN ARGUE IF YOU STILL WANT TO.
cliff_despina.again: YOUR TABLE. I KEPT IT. I KEEP IT FOR EVERYONE, BUT TONIGHT IT'S YOURS.

topics.a: AT SUNSET THE WHOLE CALDERA GOES GOLD AND THEN PINK AND THEN THE LAMPS COME ON DOWN THE ZIGZAG, ONE AFTER ANOTHER. PEOPLE SAIL FROM THE CAPITAL TO EAT HERE AND THEN FORGET TO EAT. PRESS ON THE TABLES FOR THE MENU.

THREE TERRACES AND A RIM. THE RICH LIVE UP HERE WITH THE VIEW, THE FISHERMEN LIVE DOWN THERE WITH THE FISH, AND EVERYONE IN BETWEEN LIVES ON THE STAIRS. ARIS PAINTS IT EVERY DAY AND SAYS HE HASN'T GOT IT RIGHT YET.
A MERCHANT FROM THE GLASSWORKS ON SAPPHIRE PORT ATE HERE LAST WEEK. HE SAID THE WINDMILLS COULD BLOW GLASS IF ANYONE BOTHERED TO TRY. NOBODY HAS BOTHERED.

cliff_ilias.name: Father Ilias
cliff_ilias.role: Keeps the great church on the rim
cliff_ilias.greet: PEACE ON YOU, TRAVELLER. LIGHT A LAMP IF YOU LIKE - FOR SOMEONE AT SEA, OR FOR YOURSELF. THE SEA DOESN'T MIND WHICH.
cliff_ilias.again: BACK AGAIN. GOOD. THE LAMPS LIKE TO BE VISITED.

topics.a: THREE DOMES, BLUE AS THE DEEP WATER, SO THE SEA KNOWS WHOSE HOUSE IT IS. THE BELLS ARE RUNG FOR EVERY BOAT THAT COMES IN THROUGH THE CALDERA'S MOUTH. A LAMP IS A COIN OR TWO. IT KEEPS YOU WARM ON A COLD PASSAGE, THE SAILORS SAY.
THE MOUNTAIN SLEEPS. NOW AND THEN IT TURNS OVER IN ITS SLEEP. WE RING THE BELLS SO IT KNOWS WE'RE STILL HERE, AND IT LETS US STAY. THAT IS THE ARRANGEMENT.
THE BATHHOUSE MONKS ON THE ROSE SEA SAY THE SAME WATER RUNS UNDER BOTH OUR ISLANDS. I SAY THEIR WATER IS WARMER AND THEIR THEOLOGY IS COLDER.

cliff_aris.name: Aris Velos
cliff_aris.role: Paints the caldera from the promenade
cliff_aris.greet: STAND THERE - NO, THERE. YOU'RE IN MY LIGHT. ACTUALLY STAY. THE PICTURE NEEDS A STRANGER IN IT.
cliff_aris.again: YOU AGAIN. I PUT YOU IN YESTERDAY'S. YOU LOOKED TALLER.

topics.a: TWENTY-TWO YEARS I'VE PAINTED THIS VIEW. THE BLUE IS NEVER THE SAME BLUE. TODAY IT'S SAPPHIRE. TOMORROW IT WILL BE SOMETHING THERE IS NO WORD FOR YET, AND I WILL HAVE TO INVENT ONE.
LOOK AT IT: EVERY HOUSE WHITE SO THE NEXT ONE SHOWS, EVERY DOOR BLUE SO THE HOUSE SHOWS. EVEN THE PAVING HAS ITS LINES PAINTED IN. A TOWN THAT WANTS TO BE A PICTURE. I'M ONLY TAKING DICTATION.
THERE'S A LANTERN MAKER TWO DOORS DOWN WHO SAYS HER LAMPS CAN BE SEEN FROM MIDNIGHT ISLE. I'VE NEVER BEEN TO MIDNIGHT ISLE. NEITHER HAS SHE. NEITHER OF US INTENDS TO.

market_nerys.name: Nerys Kalogeri
market_nerys.role: Buys fish at the floating market
market_nerys.greet: FISH? I'LL TAKE IT. SAPPHIRE FISH, I'LL PAY YOU OVER THE ODDS FOR. EVERYTHING ELSE, I'LL PAY YOU THE ODDS.
market_nerys.again: BACK WITH A HOLD FULL? GOOD. I'VE A CAPTAIN FROM THE CAPITAL WHO'LL BUY ANYTHING THAT GLITTERS.

topics.a: LET'S SEE IT, THEN. GLASS SWORDFISH I PAY BEST FOR ON THE FIVE SEAS - THE GLASSWORKS BUYS THE FINS.

AT DUSK WE ROW IN FROM EVERY COVE ON THE SAPPHIRE AND LASH UP TOGETHER - BOW TO STERN, ROPES CROSSWISE, THE BARGES IN THE MIDDLE FOR SQUARES. IT'S A STREET THAT SINKS IF YOU ARGUE TOO HARD. WE ARGUE ANYWAY.
THE CLIFF TOWN DOWN SOUTH - LANTERNFALL - THEIR TAVERNAS BUY FROM ME. THEY SAY THE ISLET IN THEIR BAY GLOWED LAST MONTH AND THE FISH CAME UP COOKED. I'LL BELIEVE IT WHEN I SEE A COOKED FISH.

market_kassia.name: Kassia Dragoumis
market_kassia.role: Buys crystals and ore at the floating market
market_kassia.greet: STONES, CRYSTALS, ANYTHING THAT GLOWS. SHOW ME. I CAN TELL A FAKE BY LOOKING AT YOUR FACE.
market_kassia.again: YOU AGAIN. YOUR FACE SAYS YOU'VE BROUGHT SOMETHING REAL.

topics.a: SAPPHIRE CRYSTAL I PAY BEST FOR - THE GLASSWORKS GRINDS IT INTO THE BLUE. THE REST I SELL ON TO WHOEVER'S FOOLISH.
SAPPHIRE GLASS IS BLUE BECAUSE OF WHAT'S GROUND INTO IT. THE GLASSWORKS WON'T SAY WHAT. I SELL THEM SAPPHIRE CRYSTAL BY THE SACK. DRAW YOUR OWN CONCLUSIONS.
THE ROSE SEA'S MYSTICS HAVE STARTED BUYING SONGSTONE. THEY SAY IT HUMS IN TUNE WITH THEIR HOT SPRINGS. I SAY IT HUMS IN TUNE WITH THEIR PURSES.

market_theo.name: Theo Marangos
market_theo.role: Spice boat at the floating market
market_theo.greet: SAFFRON, SALT IN SIX COLOURS, SPORE-PEPPER! AND IF YOU'VE EGGS OR HONEY FROM THE FARM WORLD, I'M BUYING.
market_theo.again: MY FAVOURITE CUSTOMER. YOU'RE ALL MY FAVOURITE CUSTOMER.

topics.a: THE COOKS UP AT LANTERNFALL AND THE CAPITAL'S KITCHENS CAN'T GET ENOUGH OF FARM HONEY. I PAY BETTER THAN THE FARM'S OWN BUYER, AND I DON'T SMELL OF GOATS.
SAPPHIRE SUGAR GLOWS IN THE DARK. SPORE-PEPPER MAKES YOUR EARS RING. THE BLACK SALT IS FROM THE LAVA ISLET AT LANTERNFALL - SCRAPED OFF THE ROCKS BY A MAN WHO WON'T SAY HOW HE GETS THERE.
OLD DORAN SAYS HE'S GOT A WATCH THAT RUNS BACKWARDS. IT DOESN'T. I CHECKED. IT JUST RUNS SLOW, LIKE DORAN.

market_doran.name: Old Doran
market_doran.role: Buys curios and treasures at the floating market
market_doran.greet: CURIOS, RELICS, ODDMENTS. I BUY THE THINGS NOBODY ELSE KNOWS THE PRICE OF, WHICH MEANS I DECIDE IT.
market_doran.again: AH. YOU. WHAT HAS THE SEA COUGHED UP FOR YOU THIS TIME?

topics.a: PEARLS, OLD COIN, A WATCH THAT STILL TICKS. I PAY FAIR. FAIR TO ME, CERTAINLY.
FIFTY YEARS I'VE MOORED IN THE SAME SPOT. THE BARGE HAS BEEN REPLACED THREE TIMES. THE ROPES, TWELVE. ME, NOT ONCE. I'M THE ONLY ORIGINAL PART OF THE FLOATING MARKET.
THE GLASSWORKS WANTS A BLOWER'S APPRENTICE. THEY TRY EVERYONE ON THE PIPE. MOST PEOPLE BLOW A BUBBLE THAT LOOKS LIKE A POTATO. GO AND LOOK A FOOL - IT'S GOOD FOR YOU.

market_lyra.name: Lyra Petrou
market_lyra.role: Glass trader at the floating market
market_lyra.greet: GLASS FLOATS, LAMP CHIMNEYS, A BOTTLE FOR EVERY SHIP. AND IF YOU'VE SEA GLASS, I'LL BUY IT - THE SEA DOES THE POLISHING FOR US.
market_lyra.again: THE LIGHT THROUGH YOUR POCKETS LOOKS GREEN. SEA GLASS?

topics.a: THE GLASSWORKS MELTS IT INTO THEIR SEA-GREEN BATCH. NOBODY ELSE ON THE SEAS PAYS THIS FOR IT.
THE CONE ON THE QUAY - YOU CAN'T MISS IT, IT'S THE THING ON FIRE. GO IN, ASK FOR THE MASTER, AND THEY'LL PUT A PIPE IN YOUR HAND. EVERYTHING YOU BLOW YOU KEEP.
THE LANTERN MAKER AT LANTERNFALL BUYS ALL OUR BLUE CHIMNEYS. SHE SAYS HER LAMPS HAVE NEVER BLOWN OUT. I SAY THE WIND DOWN THERE IS JUST VERY POLITE.

market_melina.name: Melina Sava
market_melina.role: Fruit boat at the floating market
market_melina.greet: FRUIT! FROM EVERYWHERE THE SEA GOES AND A FEW PLACES IT DOESN'T. AND I BUY FROM FARMERS, IF YOU FARM.
market_melina.again: BACK FOR MORE STARFRUIT? EVERYONE COMES BACK FOR THE STARFRUIT.

topics.a: PUMPKINS FOR THE CAPITAL'S PIES, STARFRUIT FOR THE QUEEN-REGENT'S TABLE, CARROTS FOR THE DONKEYS AT LANTERNFALL. I PAY A LITTLE OVER THE FARM'S OWN BUYER.
THE RULE IS THAT THE MARKET ISN'T OPEN UNTIL THE LAST BOAT'S LASHED. SO EVERY NIGHT SOMEBODY'S LATE, AND EVERY NIGHT WE ALL SHOUT AT THEM, AND THEN IT'S OPEN. IT'S THE BEST PART.
THEY SAY THE ROSE SEA HAS A BATHHOUSE WHERE THE WATER COMES UP HOT FROM THE CRYSTALS AND YOU COME OUT TEN YEARS YOUNGER. I WENT. I CAME OUT A DAY OLDER AND VERY CLEAN.

glass_stavrou.name: Master Stavrou
glass_stavrou.greet: MIND THE PIPES, MIND THE BUCKETS, MIND THE FURNACE, AND ABOVE ALL MIND IONE. SHE BITES.
glass_stavrou.again: BACK FOR ANOTHER GO ON THE PIPE? GOOD. THE FIRST HUNDRED ARE ALWAYS POTATOES.

topics.a: NINETY YEARS THIS FURNACE HAS BURNED. MY GRANDFATHER LIT IT WITH A COAL FROM THE LIGHTHOUSE LAMP AND NOBODY HAS DARED LET IT GO OUT SINCE. EVERY BLUE WINDOW ON THE FIVE SEAS STARTED IN THAT FIRE.

TAKE THE PIPE AT THE BENCH. GATHER FROM THE GLORY HOLE WHEN THE GLASS GLOWS JUST RIGHT - NOT TOO PALE, NOT TOO RED. BLOW WHEN IT'S SOFT. SHAPE IT WHILE IT'S STILL WARM. THREE GOOD MOMENTS AND YOU HAVE A FLOAT. MISS THEM AND YOU HAVE A STORY.
THERE IS NO SECRET. THERE IS CRUSHED SAPPHIRE CRYSTAL, A LITTLE COPPER, A LITTLE SEA, AND MY GRANDFATHER'S RECIPE WHICH I AM NOT GOING TO TELL YOU. SO: NO SECRET.

glass_ione.name: Ione Varga
glass_ione.greet: IF YOU'RE HERE TO WATCH, WATCH FROM THERE. IF YOU'RE HERE TO HELP, HAND ME THAT JACK. NO, THE OTHER ONE.
glass_ione.again: YOU AGAIN. YOUR LAST FLOAT WAS NOT TERRIBLE. I'M TOLD THAT COUNTS AS PRAISE FROM ME.

topics.a: A LAMP CHIMNEY FOR LANTERNFALL. THE LANTERN MAKER THERE TAKES FORTY A MONTH. SHE SAYS HER LAMPS NEVER BLOW OUT. THAT'S BECAUSE OF MY GLASS, NOT HER LANTERNS. DON'T TELL HER.
THE FLOATING MARKET BUYS OUR SECONDS - ANYTHING WITH A BUBBLE IN IT. THE CAPITAL GETS OUR FIRSTS. LYRA'S BOAT SELLS SEA GLASS BACK TO US FOR THE GREEN BATCH. THE SEA DOES HALF THE WORK.
THE ROSE SEA'S BATHHOUSE ORDERED A HUNDRED BLUE TILES FOR ITS GREAT POOL. MASTER STAVROU MADE ME DO THEM. A HUNDRED. ALL THE SAME. I DREAM OF THEM.

rigg.name: Wenna Rigg
rigg.greet: MIND THE CANVAS - IT'S A MAINSAIL FOR THE ADMIRALTY AND IT'S ONLY HALF HEMMED. RIGG AND DAUGHTERS. I'M THE DAUGHTERS.
rigg.again: BACK ON GUILD ROW? SIT ON THE BENCH, NOT THE SAIL.

topics.a: MY GRANDFATHER CUT SAILS FOR THE SOVEREIGN. MY MOTHER CUT THEM FOR THE QUEEN-REGENT'S BARGE. I CUT THEM FOR WHOEVER PAYS, WHICH IS MOSTLY FISHERMEN, WHICH IS HOW I LIKE IT. FISHERMEN SAY THANK YOU.
CANVAS BY THE BOLT, ROPE BY THE COIL, FOR YOUR OWN WORKSHOP. CHEAPER THAN THE ROSE ISLES, AND I WON'T PRETEND IT'S SILK.
SAILS, CHARTS, INSTRUMENTS, BARRELS, ROPE. A SHIP NEEDS ALL OF US BEFORE SHE NEEDS A CAPTAIN. TELL THAT TO A CAPTAIN AND WATCH HIS FACE.
OLD BRASSWORTH NEXT DOOR HAS BUILT A CLOCK THAT KEEPS LUMAR'S HOURS AT SEA. EIGHT HOURS ROUND THE FACE. HE WON'T SHUT UP ABOUT IT. GO AND LET HIM TELL YOU, IT'LL MAKE HIS WEEK.

penn.name: Marisol Penn
penn.greet: DON'T BREATHE ON THAT ONE, THE INK'S WET. A NEW COASTLINE OFF THE SAPPHIRE ISLES - THE SEA MOVED A HEADLAND AGAIN.
penn.again: AH, THE CAPTAIN. ANY SOUNDINGS FOR ME?

topics.a: I TRAINED UNDER ILSA VENN'S AUNT IN THE MARKET SQUARE, AND THEN I CAME TO THE CAPITAL WHERE THE ADMIRALTY PAYS IN GOLD AND COMPLAINS IN WRITING.
EVERY SEA I'VE DRAWN, AND I'VE DRAWN THEM ALL. ONCE A SEA'S ON YOUR CHART, YOU CAN SET A COURSE FOR ANY ISLAND IN IT.
EVERY CHARTMAKER HAS A DRAWER WITH A SIXTH SEA IN IT. MINE IS EMPTY PAPER WITH A COMPASS ROSE IN THE CORNER. ONE DAY SOMEBODY WILL BRING ME SOMETHING TO PUT ON IT.
THE FISHING FLEET TELLS ME MORE THAN THE ADMIRALTY. OUT AT DAWN, HOME AT DUSK, AND THEY KNOW EVERY ROCK BY ITS FIRST NAME.

brassworth.name: Oswin Brassworth
brassworth.greet: COME IN, COME IN, DON'T TOUCH THE ORRERY. SEXTANTS, COMPASSES, TELESCOPES - AND THE FINEST CHRONOMETER ON THE FIVE SEAS, IF I SAY SO MYSELF. I DO SAY SO.
brassworth.again: AH! YOU'RE BACK. HAS IT DRIFTED? IT HASN'T DRIFTED.

topics.a: FIFTY YEARS OF BRASS AND GLASS. THE CHAPELS RING LUMAR'S HOURS, YES, BUT A CHAPEL BELL DOESN'T COME TO SEA WITH YOU. SO I MADE ONE THAT DOES.
EIGHT HOURS ROUND THE FACE: LUMAR'S DAY. GIMBALLED IN BRASS, SPRUNG IN SEA-STEEL, WOUND ONCE A WEEK. KEEP IT ON YOU AND YOU'LL ALWAYS KNOW THE HOUR ON THE SEAS.
THE OBSERVATORY ON THE HILL SAYS THE SPORES WILL BLOOM AGAIN SOON. THE WHOLE SEA LIGHTS UP, YOU KNOW. A NIGHT OR TWO A MONTH. I SET MY TELESCOPE ON THE ROOF AND LOOK DOWN INSTEAD OF UP.

crier.name: Barnaby Toll
crier.greet: OYEZ, OYEZ! HEAR YE - OH, IT'S JUST ONE OF YOU. OYEZ ANYWAY. I'M PAID BY THE OYEZ.
crier.again: OYEZ! THE NEWS, THE NEWS, A COPPER FOR THE NEWS! NO? FREE TO YOU, THEN.

topics.a: THE LANTERN THEATRE HAS A NEW PLAY EVERY EVENING! THE CROWN'S REGATTA SAILS ON FRIDAYS! A CAT NAMED ADMIRAL IS MISSING AND IS, I AM TOLD, ON THE ROOF OF THE OLD KEEP, LOOKING SMUG!
THE OLDEST STONES IN CROWNHAVEN! THE KEEP, THE WALL, THE WELL. THE HARBOUR CAME LATER, THE PALACE LATER STILL. THE NEW TOWN THINKS IT'S VERY GRAND. THE NEW TOWN IS THREE HUNDRED YEARS OLD.

NORTH GATE FOR THE CANALS AND GUILD ROW, AND THE FUNICULAR UP TO THE HILL! THE BRIDGE GATE FOR THE OLD BRIDGE OVER THE HARBOUR MOUTH! THE LAND GATE FOR THE HARBOUR AND THE GRAND SQUARE! ALL ROADS LEAD TO SOMEWHERE THAT SELLS PIES!

harrow.name: Commodore Harrow
harrow.role: Master of the Royal Naval Academy
harrow.greet: STAND STRAIGHT. NO - STRAIGHTER. HMM. YOU HAVE THE LOOK OF SOMEONE WHO'S SAILED HER OWN BOAT. THE CADETS COULD LEARN FROM THAT, THOUGH I WON'T TELL THEM SO.
harrow.again: BACK ON THE HILL. THE MAST IS THERE IF YOU WANT TO SHOW MY CADETS HOW IT'S DONE.

topics.a: THIRTY YEARS ON THE CROWN'S QUARTERDECKS, TWELVE TEACHING CHILDREN WHICH END OF A SHIP IS THE FRONT. THE SECOND IS HARDER.
UP THE RATLINES AT DAWN, OUT ALONG THE YARDS, DOWN AGAIN BEFORE THE BELL. THEN KNOTS, THEN STARS, THEN GUNNERY, THEN BED. THEY ALL WANT TO SAIL THE CRIMSON. HALF OF THEM WILL.
THE ARSENAL HAS A FIRST-RATE ON THE STOCKS. THE SOVEREIGN II. THE QUEEN-REGENT WANTS HER LAUNCHED FOR THE REGATTA. THE SHIPWRIGHTS WANT ANOTHER TWO YEARS. THE SHIPWRIGHTS WILL WIN.

ione.name: Dr Ione Vesper
ione.greet: SHH. NO - IT'S ALL RIGHT, THE STAR CAN'T HEAR YOU. I JUST LIKE TO BE QUIET WITH THEM. COME AND LOOK.
ione.again: AH, MY FELLOW STARGAZER. THE SKY'S CLEAR TONIGHT, OR IT WILL BE.

topics.a: I KEEP THE CROWN'S TIME AND THE CROWN'S STARS. EVERY CHART PENN DRAWS IS FIXED BY A STAR I MEASURED. SHE NEVER THANKS ME. I NEVER THANK HER. IT'S A VERY HAPPY ARRANGEMENT.

A NIGHT OR TWO EACH MONTH THE SPORES IN THE SEA ALL WAKE AT ONCE AND THE WHOLE OCEAN LIGHTS UP - EMERALD HERE, BLUE OFF SAPPHIRE, ROSE IN THE ROSE ISLES. I TURN THE TELESCOPE DOWN FOR IT. IT'S THE ONLY TIME THE SEA OUTSHINES THE SKY.
THE BRASS ONE ON THE TERRACE IS FOR VISITORS. USE IT. THE GREAT ONE IN THE DOME IS FOR ME, AND FOR THE QUEEN-REGENT ON HER BIRTHDAY, AND FOR NOBODY ELSE, EVER, SO DON'T ASK.
SOMETHING CROSSED THE MOON LAST WEEK THAT WASN'T A BIRD OR A CLOUD. IT WAS SHAPED LIKE A SHIP. THE ADMIRALTY SAYS I'M TIRED. I AM TIRED. IT WAS STILL A SHIP.

mudlark.name: Gull Molly
mudlark.greet: MIND THE HEAP. EVERYTHING IN IT CAME OUT OF THE HARBOUR MUD WITH MY OWN TWO HANDS, AND EVERYTHING IN IT'S FOR SALE. EXCEPT THE BOOT. THE BOOT'S MINE.
mudlark.again: BACK FOR MORE TREASURE? THE TIDE BROUGHT IN SOMETHING SHINY THIS MORNING.

topics.a: BORN ON THE STILTS, RAISED ON THE STILTS, WILL DIE ON THE STILTS, PROBABLY FALLING OFF ONE. LOW TIDE I'M IN THE MUD UNDER THE QUAY. HIGH TIDE I'M SELLING WHAT I FOUND.
SEA GLASS - THE GREEN'S FROM THE CROWN'S OWN WINDOWS, SMASHED IN THE STORM OF '12. SILVER NAILS OFF A WRECK NOBODY REMEMBERS. GO ON, HAVE A ROOT.
UP THERE THEY'VE GOT THE PALACE AND THE EXCHANGE AND THE THEATRE. DOWN HERE WE'VE GOT THE UNDERTOW, THE BEST FRIED FISH IN CROWNHAVEN, AND NOBODY TELLING US TO WIPE OUR FEET.
THE FISHING FLEET COMES IN UNDER THE QUAY AT DUSK AND THE CATCH GOES UP FOR AUCTION. GET THERE EARLY AND YOU'LL SEE THE AUCTIONEER CHEAT. GET THERE LATE AND YOU'LL SEE HIM GET CAUGHT.

rose_seren.name: Seren Halloway
rose_seren.role: Weaves spore silk in Rosewell's groves
rose_seren.greet: SHH - THE MOTHS ARE SPINNING. THEY ONLY SPIN WHEN NOBODY'S SHOUTING. YOU CAN TALK. QUIETLY.
rose_seren.again: BACK AMONG THE TREES. THE MOTHS REMEMBER YOU. THEY'RE NOT SURE YET WHAT THEY THINK.

topics.a: THE MOTHS FEED ON THE SPORES THAT COME UP WITH THE SPRINGS' STEAM, AND WHAT THEY SPIN GLOWS. WE WAIT TILL THEY'VE FLOWN, GATHER THE EMPTY COCOONS, BOIL THEM IN SPRING WATER AND UNWIND THEM. A MILE OF THREAD IN EACH. THE ROSE SILK COMPANY SHIPS IT EVERYWHERE.
THE TREES BY THE DRYING LINES HAVE EMPTY COCOONS MOST DAYS - GATHER WHAT'S RIPE. BRING ME FIVE AND I'LL PUT THEM ON THE LOOM FOR YOU: A SCARF, GLOWING. OR I'LL BUY THEM, IF YOU'D RATHER THE MONEY.
A MERCHANT FROM SAPPHIRE TRIED TO BUY A MOTH. A WHOLE LIVE MOTH. TO BREED. THE MOTH FLEW OUT OF HIS HAND AND STRAIGHT BACK TO ITS TREE. THE MOTHS KNOW WHERE THEY'RE FROM.

rose_amaryllis.name: Mother Amaryllis
rose_amaryllis.role: Reads the steam at the foot of the terraces
rose_amaryllis.greet: SIT. NO - DON'T TELL ME WHY YOU'VE COME. THE STEAM WILL. IT ALWAYS DOES, AND IT'S RUDER THAN I AM.
rose_amaryllis.again: THE STEAM'S BEEN TALKING ABOUT YOU. NOTHING BAD. NOTHING YOU'D WANT REPEATED, EITHER.

topics.a: I READ THE STEAM OFF THE SPRINGS. IT RISES THROUGH THE CRYSTALS AND THE CRYSTALS REMEMBER THINGS - WHAT THE SEA IS DOING, WHERE THE FISH ARE, WHO'S LYING. A FEW COINS AND I'LL TELL YOU WHAT IT SAYS. IT'S USUALLY TRUE. IT'S ALWAYS INTERESTING.

MAKERS AND MYSTICS, THE CAPITAL CALLS US, AS IF THEY WERE DIFFERENT THINGS. THE WEAVER MAKES SILK FROM A MOTH'S DREAM. THE BATHHOUSE MAKES OLD SAILORS YOUNG FOR AN HOUR. LIOR MAKES TEA THAT TELLS YOU HOW YOU FEEL. WHICH OF THOSE IS NOT MAGIC?
THE STEAM SAYS A CLIFF TOWN ON THE SAPPHIRE RINGS ITS BELLS TO KEEP A MOUNTAIN ASLEEP. THE STEAM THINKS THIS IS VERY FUNNY. THE STEAM HAS NEVER MET A MOUNTAIN.

rose_oda.name: Oda Brenn
rose_oda.greet: BOOTS OFF, CARES OFF, IN YOU GO. THE WATER'S HOT AS IT COMES OUT OF THE HILL, SO GO SLOW ON THE STEPS.
rose_oda.again: BACK FOR A SOAK? GOOD. YOU LOOK LIKE A CAPTAIN WHO'S BEEN STANDING IN THE RAIN.

topics.a: A FEW COINS AND THE WATER DOES THE REST: IT TAKES THE ACHE OUT, AND THE COLD - THE COLD STAYS OUT OF YOU FOR HOURS AFTER. THE ICE WORLD'S CLIMBERS COME ALL THIS WAY FOR IT. PRESS ON THE BATH WHEN YOU'RE READY.
THEY COME UP THROUGH THE ROSEITE, WHICH IS WHY THE WATER'S PINK AND WHY YOUR SKIN TINGLES. DON'T DRINK IT. WELL - DRINK A LITTLE. NOT AS MUCH AS OLD PELL FROM TERN HOLM DID. WE DON'T TALK ABOUT THAT.
THE TILES ARE FROM THE SAPPHIRE GLASSWORKS. THE GIRL WHO MADE THEM CAME TO BATHE HERE ONCE AND SPENT THE WHOLE HOUR COUNTING THEM. SHE SAID SHE FOUND THE ONE THAT WAS DIFFERENT. I'VE NEVER FOUND IT.

rose_lior.name: Master Lior
rose_lior.role: Keeps the tea house over the pools
rose_lior.greet: YOU HAVE ARRIVED. THE KETTLE KNEW BEFORE I DID. SIT; THE WATER IS NEARLY READY. IT IS ALWAYS NEARLY READY.
rose_lior.again: AH. THE CAPTAIN WHO DRINKS TOO FAST. SIT. TODAY YOU WILL DRINK SLOWLY.

topics.a: ROSEHIP FOR THE TIRED. EMBERLEAF FOR THE COLD - IT WARMS YOU FROM THE INSIDE FOR A LONG WHILE. MOONLEAF FOR THE HURT. ASK FOR A POT AT THE HEARTH. I WILL TELL YOU WHICH ONE YOU NEED, AND YOU WILL ORDER ANOTHER, AND THAT IS ALSO FINE.
THE SPRINGS MADE THE TERRACES, THE TERRACES MADE THE POOLS, THE POOLS MADE THE BATHHOUSE, THE BATHHOUSE MADE THE TOWN. NOBODY PLANNED ANY OF IT. THAT IS WHY IT IS BEAUTIFUL.

THE TEA IN THE PLAIN JAR CAME FROM A SAILOR WHO SAID HE HAD BEEN TO A SIXTH SEA. HE PAID FOR ONE POT WITH THE WHOLE JAR AND NEVER CAME BACK. I DRINK A LEAF OF IT ON THE LONGEST NIGHT. IT TASTES OF SOMEWHERE ELSE.

hobb.name: Hobb Tanner
hobb.role: Keeps the livery on Station Road, Brambleford
hobb.greet: MIND THE GOAT. SHE BITES THE ONES SHE LIKES. YOU'LL BE AFTER A HORSE, I EXPECT - EVERYONE'S AFTER A HORSE ONCE THEY'VE SEEN THE DOWNS.
hobb.again: BACK AGAIN. THE HORSES REMEMBER YOU. SO DOES THE GOAT.

topics.a: HOBB TANNER. MY FATHER KEPT THIS YARD, AND HIS. HORSES, HARNESS, THE ODD BUGGY MENDED. I KNOW EVERY LANE BETWEEN HERE AND THE RIVER BY THE SOUND OF THE HOOVES ON IT.
OVER THE OLD BRIDGE - WHEN SOMEBODY MENDS IT - THE LAND GOES UP IN GREEN WAVES ALL THE WAY TO THISTLECOMBE. HEDGES, LARKS, A FARM STAND EVERY MILE. YOU WANT TO SEE IT FROM A SADDLE.
QUIET END OF THE VILLAGE THESE DAYS. TEA ROOMS SHUT, DAIRY EMPTY, THE HALT CLOSED. THE VILLAGE FUND ON THE GREEN COULD CHANGE ALL THAT, IF ANYONE PUT ANYTHING IN IT.

juniper.name: Juniper Lowe
juniper.role: Runs the Kettle & Crumb café, Station Road
juniper.greet: YOU'RE THE ONE WHO PUT THE MONEY IN THE TIN! SIT ANYWHERE. NOT THAT CHAIR, IT WOBBLES. ACTUALLY THAT CHAIR'S FINE, IT'S THE FLOOR.
juniper.again: THE USUAL? I'M DECIDING WHAT YOUR USUAL IS. IT'S A SCONE.

topics.a: BRIDGET'S NIECE. I BAKED IN THISTLECOMBE FOR SIX YEARS AND ALWAYS MEANT TO COME HOME AND DO IT PROPERLY. NOW I HAVE. IT'S MOSTLY WASHING UP.
WHATEVER GROWS ROUND HERE. YOUR STRAWBERRIES IN THE JAM, YOUR PUMPKINS IN THE SOUP, YOUR APPLES AND HONEY IN THE GRANOLA. BRING ME THE GOOD STUFF AND I'LL CHALK YOUR FARM'S NAME UP ON THE BOARD.
OATS FROM LUDD'S, HONEY FROM THE SKEPS, APPLES OFF THE TREES, TOASTED SLOW. VERY LOCAL. I COULD WALK YOU ROUND EVERY FIELD IN IT BEFORE LUNCH.
MR PIKE HAS POLISHED THE SAME BRASS LAMP FOUR TIMES THIS WEEK. HE SAYS IT'S FOR THE INSPECTOR. THERE IS NO INSPECTOR.

hester.name: Hester Wold
hester.role: Cheesemaker at the Wold Dairy, Station Road
hester.greet: COME IN, SHUT THE DOOR, THE CHEESE DOESN'T LIKE A DRAUGHT. NOR DO I. TRY THIS - THE BLUE. GO ON.
hester.again: BACK FOR MORE? THE HARD ONE'S AT ITS BEST THIS WEEK.

topics.a: WOLD COUNTRY BORN, OVER THE HILLS. MY MOTHER MADE CHEESE AND SO DID HERS. I CAME HERE FOR THE MILK - THE GRASS ON VERDANCE MAKES A SWEETER CHEESE THAN ANYWHERE.
BRING ME FOUR PAILS AND LEAVE THEM WITH ME. I'LL SET IT, PRESS IT, SALT IT, TURN IT, AND IN A DAY YOU'VE A ROUND OF YOUR OWN FARMHOUSE CHEESE. IT FETCHES A GOOD DEAL MORE THAN THE MILK.
I'LL TAKE IT. FAIR PRICE.

pike.name: Albert Pike
pike.greet: GOOD DAY. THE NEXT TRAIN IS DUE, AND IT WILL BE ON TIME, BECAUSE IT ALWAYS IS NOW. MIND THE YELLOW LINE.

topics.a: FORTY YEARS ON THE BRANCH LINE, MAN AND BOY, AND NINE OF THEM WITH THE HALT SHUT AND ME TENDING THE LAMPS ANYWAY. YOU DON'T STOP BEING A STATIONMASTER BECAUSE THE TRAINS DO.
SOUTH OVER THE RIVER ON THE GIRDER BRIDGE, ROUND THE FOOT OF THE DOWNS AND INTO THISTLECOMBE BY THE WHARF. A FEW MINUTES. WATCH FOR THE WHITE HORSE CUT IN THE CHALK ON THE RIGHT.

marigold.name: Marigold Larkin
marigold.role: Grows flowers at Larkspur, on the Downs
marigold.greet: HELLO, HELLO! MIND THE DAHLIAS, THEY'RE SHOWING OFF. ARE YOU A GROWER? YOU'VE GOT GROWER'S HANDS. OR MUD. SAME THING.
marigold.again: BACK! THE SWEET PEAS ARE OUT. SMELL THAT.

topics.a: MY GRAN STARTED LARKSPUR WITH A ROW OF SWEET PEAS AND A BICYCLE. NOW IT'S SIX ACRES OF COLOUR AND STILL ONE BICYCLE. I SELL TO THE WEDDINGS IN THISTLECOMBE AND THE CAFE IN BRAMBLEFORD AND ANYONE WHO STOPS.
MY PRIDE AND JOY. THEY GROW LIKE ANYTHING BUT THEY ONLY OPEN AFTER DARK, AND THEN THEY GLOW - PALE AS THE MOONS. PLANT SOME, WATER THEM, AND PICK THEM AT NIGHT. I'LL BUY EVERY ONE YOU BRING ME.

OLD SEED, OLDER THAN THE CHALK HORSE, THEY SAY. IT ONLY GROWS BY MOONLIGHT - BOTH OUR MOONS. ON A NIGHT THE LANTERN AND THE BUTTON ARE BOTH FULL IT FAIRLY LEAPS OUT OF THE GROUND. THE CHEFS IN ARCADIA GO MAD FOR THEM.
THE STAND AT THE CROSSROADS? ANYONE CAN USE IT. PUT YOUR STUFF OUT, WALKERS PUT THE MONEY IN THE TIN. MOSTLY. ONCE SOMEONE LEFT ME A TORTOISE.

ezra.name: Ezra Cobb
ezra.role: Presses cider at Cobb's, on the Downs
ezra.greet: ARR. YOU'LL BE WANTING CIDER. EVERYONE WANTS CIDER. THEY DON'T ALWAYS WANT IT THE MORNING AFTER.

topics.a: COBBS HAVE PRESSED CIDER ON THIS HILL FOR NINE GENERATIONS. THE PRESS IS OLDER THAN THE BARN. THE BARN IS OLDER THAN ME. I AM OLDER THAN I LOOK, WHICH IS SAYING SOMETHING.
BRING ME APPLES - A DOZEN TO THE BOTTLE - AND I'LL PRESS 'EM AND PUT 'EM IN THE CASK. TWO DAYS AND IT'S YOURS, WITH YOUR FARM'S NAME ON. TASTES OF WHERE IT GREW. THAT'S THE WHOLE TRICK.
SCOURED HER EVERY SPRING SINCE I WAS A NIPPER. WHOLE VILLAGE UP THE HILL WITH BRUSHES. THEN EVERYONE COMES DOWN HERE AFTER. FUNNY, THAT.

ada.name: Ada Ember
ada.role: Roasts coffee at Ember & Bean, Thistlecombe
ada.greet: SMELL THAT? THAT'S A FULL CITY ROAST AND IT'S PERFECT AND I'M VERY TIRED. COFFEE?
ada.again: BACK! THE NEW BATCH IS RESTING. IT'S AN AWKWARD AGE.

topics.a: I GREW UP IN ARCADIA ON VENDING-MACHINE COFFEE. CAME TO VERDANCE FOR A WEEKEND, TASTED A BEAN FROM THE HILLS ABOVE THISTLECOMBE, AND NEVER WENT BACK. NINE YEARS OF ROASTING AND I STILL BURN ONE BATCH A WEEK.
JUNIPER IN BRAMBLEFORD? SHE BUYS MY BEANS NOW. SHE ALSO ARGUES WITH ME ABOUT MILK. WE'RE GOING TO BE GREAT FRIENDS.
SATURDAYS THE WHOLE COUNTRYSIDE COMES IN. I SELL MORE COFFEE BEFORE TEN THAN ALL WEEK. GET A STALL - EFFIE BRIGHT WILL KEEP IT FOR YOU, SHE'S A TERROR WITH CHANGE.

wren.name: Wren Potts
wren.greet: OH - HELLO. SORRY, CLAY EVERYWHERE. ON ME, MOSTLY. HAVE A LOOK, THE BLUE ONES ARE NEW.
wren.again: HELLO AGAIN! I SAVED YOU A SECOND. IT'S ONLY A LITTLE WONKY.

topics.a: I TRAINED IN CROWNHAVEN, ON LUMAR, WITH A POTTER WHO SHOUTED. CAME HOME TO THISTLECOMBE AND BUILT A KILN THAT DOESN'T. THE BLUE GLAZE IS THE RIVER - I MIX IN SILT FROM THE WEND.
IT TAKES A DAY TO HEAT AND TWO TO COOL. IN WINTER THE CATS OF THISTLECOMBE QUEUE UP BESIDE IT. I DON'T CHARGE THEM.

silas.name: Silas Wick
silas.greet: GOOD DAY. YOU'LL FORGIVE THE SMELL OF HONEY, IT'S RATHER THE POINT. KEEP BEES, DO YOU? YOU'VE THE LOOK.
silas.again: AH. THE BEEKEEPER. WHAT HAVE THE BEES MADE THIS WEEK?

topics.a: WICKS ON MY FATHER'S SIDE, COMBS ON MY MOTHER'S. THE SHOP WAS INEVITABLE. I DIP TAPERS, POUR PILLARS, AND I RENDER THE COMB FROM EVERY HIVE FOR TEN MILES.
BRING ME HONEY IN THE COMB - FOUR WILL DO. I TAKE THE WAX, DIP YOU A BUNDLE OF CANDLES FROM IT, AND GIVE YOU THE HONEY BACK STRAINED, IN ONE OF WREN'S CROCKS. YOU COME OUT AHEAD TWICE.

okoro.name: Ms Okoro
okoro.role: Packs produce for Arcadia at Verdant & Co., Thistlecombe wharf
okoro.greet: AH - A GROWER. GOOD. ARCADIA'S KITCHENS ARE STARVING FOR THE REAL THING AND I'M THE ONE WHO GETS IT THERE. SIT. NO, DON'T SIT, THERE ARE CRATES.
okoro.again: YOU AGAIN. GOOD. THE CHEFS ASKED AFTER YOUR FARM.

topics.a: EIGHT YEARS IN ARCADIA'S FOOD TRADE, SIXTY FLOORS UP. I WAS SENT HERE TO 'OPTIMISE THE SUPPLY'. I OPTIMISED IT BY MOVING HERE. THE POD GOES UP EVERY EVENING; I SLEEP VERY WELL.

EVERY DAY THREE OF THE KITCHENS SEND A WISH LIST: CHEF MORI AT AURUM, MIYU AT THE NOODLE BAR, THE ROYALE'S LOUNGE. FILL ONE AND THEY PAY WELL OVER MARKET - AND THEY LEARN YOUR FARM'S NAME. ANYTHING ELSE GOOD, I'LL CRATE UP FOR THE POD.
THE CHEFS LOSE THEIR MINDS FOR THEM. MORI WILL PUT ONE MELON ON SIX PLATES AND CHARGE FOR SIXTY. GROW THEM BY MOONLIGHT - MARIGOLD ON THE DOWNS HAS THE SEED.

rudd.name: Old Rudd
rudd.role: Keeps the ferry on the Wend, Thistlecombe
rudd.greet: FERRY? UP TO THE MILL, ACROSS TO VINEHALLOW LANDING, OR JUST THE PLEASURE OF THE RIVER. TUPPENCE. SIX COINS, NOWADAYS. THE DUCKS GO FREE.

topics.a: SIXTY YEARS ON THE WEND. I KNOW EVERY HERON BY NAME AND THEY KNOW ME. THE CHAIN FERRY WAS MY GRANDAD'S. HE TALKED LESS THAN I DO, WHICH WAS HARD.
THE WEND RISES UP IN THE HILLS ABOVE VINEHALLOW, TURNS LUDD'S WHEEL AT THE MILL HAMLET, AND RUNS DOWN PAST US TO THE SEA. BEST TROUT IN VERDANCE UNDER THE MILL WEIR. DON'T TELL ANYONE.

rosalind.name: Rosalind Vane
rosalind.role: Makes the wine at the Vane estate, Vinehallow
rosalind.greet: WELCOME TO VINEHALLOW. YOU'VE CLIMBED THE HILL - THAT DESERVES A GLASS. NOT THAT ONE. THAT ONE'S NOT READY. NOTHING GOOD IS EVER READY WHEN YOU WANT IT.
rosalind.again: BACK UP THE HILL. HOW ARE YOUR CASKS COMING ALONG?

topics.a: SEVENTH VANE TO KEEP THESE TERRACES. MY GREAT-GREAT-GRANDMOTHER BUILT HALF THOSE WALLS WITH HER OWN HANDS AND COMPLAINED ABOUT EVERY STONE. I'VE INHERITED THE VINES AND THE COMPLAINING.

PICK FROM THE ROWS ON THE LEVEL - A BASKET A ROW EACH DAY, ANY TIME BUT WINTER. TEN BUNCHES MAKE A CASK. I'LL PRESS IT AND PUT IT DOWN IN THE CELLAR WITH YOUR NAME ON IT. A WEEK MAKES IT WINE, THREE A RESERVE, SIX A GRAND CRU. REAL WEEKS. WINE DOESN'T HURRY FOR ANYONE.
MS OKORO DOWN AT THE THISTLECOMBE WHARF SENDS OUR RED UP TO THE CITY. CHEF MORI AT AURUM POURS THE RESERVE BY THE THIMBLE AND CHARGES LIKE IT'S MOLTEN GOLD. GOOD FOR HIM.

tobias_ludd.name: Tobias Ludd
tobias_ludd.greet: MIND THE SACKS. AND THE CAT. AND THE OTHER CAT. YOU'LL HAVE MET MY DAD IN BRAMBLEFORD - HE STILL RUNS THAT LITTLE MILL OF HIS FOR THE FUN OF IT. THIS ONE DOES THE REAL WORK.

topics.a: BORN IN A MILL, RAISED IN A MILL, I'LL PROBABLY BE GROUND INTO FLOUR IN A MILL. DAD TAUGHT ME TO DRESS A STONE BEFORE I COULD READ. MARTHA - MY WIFE - RUNS THE BAKEHOUSE AND THE HAMLET AND ME.

GROW WHEAT - I SELL THE SEED - AND BRING IT HERE. THREE SHEAVES MAKE A SACK OF FLOUR. BRIDGET AT THE CRUSTY LOAF BUYS FLOUR, AND SO DOES THE CAFE ON STATION ROAD. OR MARTHA WILL BAKE IT INTO LOAVES FOR YOU NEXT DOOR.
BEST TROUT ON VERDANCE IN THE POOL UNDER THE WEIR. OLD RUDD THINKS IT'S A SECRET. EVERYONE KNOWS. NOBODY TELLS HIM.
